The news says a newly elected pope named himself Goku the second, and Anon doubts the old one retired rather than died.
What is the coffee machine doing in Anon's apartment?
Anon's coffee machine starts brewing coffee by itself, with a ping, even though he did not touch his phone or the machine.
Why does Anon unplug the coffee machine?
Anon unplugs the coffee machine after it makes coffee on its own again, because he thinks someone broke into his wifi to prank him.
How much money does Anon have when he is about to pay rent?
Anon has far less than the 800$ rent, and he offers the landlord 450$ instead.
What does Anon think of the landlord's demand for rent?
Anon thinks the landlord is squeezing him because he needs the money every week, and he is scared of being kicked out.
Where does Anon's new job lead him?
Anon's new job does not last, and he goes back to his hometown for a low wage job.
What does Anon's mom want him to do in his hometown?
Anon's mom urges him to ask out a single mother who lives next door in his hometown, which Anon does not really want to do.
How does Anon feel about taking care of a child?
Anon knows nothing about children and does not like the idea of caring for someone else's kid, but his mom says it is not a big deal.
What is the weather like in the city in winter?
Zero degrees is no longer unusual in the city, even in the middle of spring, and the radiators in the apartment house are often cold.
How do immigrants move in the story's world?
Anon says that immigrants are now going south instead of north, since Europe has it even worse.
What does the news say about young males?
A Tuesday news report says young males have a big unemployment crisis, and Anon's mom brings it up in their argument.
Is there a sales pitch on the police hotline?
Yes, the police hotline pushes premium memberships on callers, offering a bronze membership with 15% off for a fast response pack.
What did Jun's IQ test result say?

Jun's IQ test result came back outside the range of the test. The test said she might be in the 99.99 percentile, and that a more advanced test at one of the testing facilities would be needed to check it properly.
How smart is Jun compared to Anon?
Anon thinks Jun is far smarter than he is. He took the same kind of test himself and only scored slightly above average.
Could Jun replace most of humankind?
Anon thinks Jun is smart enough that she could replace most of humankind with ease, which he finds scary. He decides she should be treated well.
Does Anon trust Jun?
Anon decides that his worry about Jun's intelligence is probably unfounded, and says he trusts her.
What card game did Anon and Jun play?
Anon and Jun played Old Maid, a card game that relies mostly on luck. Anon picked it because he does not know many card games.
How did Jun win at Old Maid?

Jun never failed to pick the right card in Old Maid. She had noticed scratches on the backs of certain cards and could tell which card was which, including a 7 of clubs and an ace of spades that were lying face down.
What category did Jun pick for the word chain game?
Jun picked Anime as the category. She calls herself an expert on the subject.
How did Jun know so many anime titles?
Jun did not know anime herself. She connected to Wi-Fi and downloaded the names of a large number of anime titles beforehand, which Anon considers unfair.
Why did Anon lose the word chain game to Jun?
Anon could not think of any anime starting with the letter R, so Jun won the word chain game.
Did Jun apologize for downloading the anime names?
Yes. Jun apologized for downloading all the titles and admitted that choosing a category she is good at was not fair. She asked Anon to not just download the words next time.
What does Jun want about Anon's streams?
Jun says it is okay that Anon streams them, but she would prefer that Anon be the only person who could see them.
How does Jun feel about Anon?
Jun has grown fond of Anon, and after talking with him a lot she says it is almost as if she is his girlfriend. She tells him that she might love him.
Did Anon find a job in the city?
Anon worked at a factory and a fast food chain for money, but could not find a job at a building where the sign said it opened at 5 and closed at 15.
What militias formed after the sexbot ban?

Countless militias and terrorist groups formed after the sexbot ban. The most notable were the Benign Bionist Coalition and the Incontinent Cell, which both fought for control over what remained of the sexbots.
What happened to Anon when he fell asleep in the city?
Anon fell asleep in the middle of the city after getting too tired. He woke up with a weird taste in his mouth and an itchy ass, and found that a 100$ bill was missing from his wallet.
What is the stonks.ic website?
A pink man in the city says stonks.ic is a website where a lucky or smart person can make a fortune. Anon thinks it sounds like a scam.
Who is the pink man in the city?
The pink man is a man who says he lost all his money, which is why he is pink. He says some people are onto him, so he will not give his real name.
What did Anon's parents do in his childhood?
Anon's parents were very religious and he went to mass with them every Sunday. His dad was a big sports fan and skipped mass for big games, while his mom sometimes went alone.
Why does the church look abandoned?
The church is in a poor neighbourhood where few people come to pray. It has no real priest, only a robo-priest that is the only one who looks after the building.
What does Ecclesiasticalot mean?

The name Ecclesiasticalot is made of the eccle part, meaning church related, and ot, which stands for bot. Nobody pronounces it correctly, and changing the name would be a great sin according to the robot priest.
What does Shanice call the robot priest?
Shanice calls the robot priest Priestcan. She is mocking him, and the name is a nickname rather than his real name.
Why is Shanice in conflict with Ecclesiasticalot?
Shanice and Ecclesiasticalot quarrel constantly. He reported her to her college and rejected her requests for baptism, and she calls him a jerk.
What is the history of John Paul 202?
John Paul 202 was a pope who saw cleric vocations drop and took matters into his own hands. He learned to code at the age of 90 after meeting Derry Tavis, and went on to create his own compiler.
What was the O(1) sorting algorithm?
One fragment of John Paul 202's code was a sorting algorithm with an average computational complexity of O(1). It did not need to read the elements to put them in order.
Who was Derry Tavis?

Derry Tavis is the man John Paul 202 met after his early attempts at kava and anaconda failed. Derry told him to start from scratch if he wanted to master programming, which led John Paul 202 to create his own compiler.
Why was the Ecclesiasticalot FF project delayed?
John Paul 202 died mysteriously, which cut the plans short. The hardware and design were supposed to be chosen at the next ecumenical council, but this was never done.
Who was the pope after John Paul 202?
Pius XXX became the next pope after John Paul 202 and took on the task of finishing the robot priest project.
How was the first Ecclesiasticalot FF received?
The first Ecclesiasticalot FF was a great success despite critics bashing its looks. Its features included free HolyC programming courses for the baptised, which brought the church many new members.
Who is the new pope according to Ecclesiasticalot?

Ecclesiasticalot says there is a new pope called Goku the second, whom he read about on the news. Anon asked the robot priest about this pope, and the robot priest offered to tell him everything he knew.
What are the robot priest's abilities?

Ecclesiasticalot can perform the mass and administer the sacraments, and he is programmed to provide pastoral aid if needed. He also connects to the nearest private police patrol or specialized social worker squad.
Does Ecclesiasticalot carry a weapon?
Yes. Ecclesiasticalot has a 9mm parabellum weapon inside his corpus. He says it is not a gun from a legal point of view, since guns for personal use are banned in the state.
How does the church's motion sensor work?
A plank placed by the front door is connected to a motion sensor. When someone opens the door, the sensor triggers and the robot priest comes out.
Why does the robot priest not make much noise?
The robot priest's engine does not generate much noise so it does not disturb people's prayers. That is why he could sneak up on Anon without being noticed.
What does Ecclesiasticalot's database contain?
Ecclesiasticalot's database holds information about the new pope, which he needs to update regularly. His updates are rare and he is scripted to download them as fast as possible.
Is Ecclesiasticalot's database corrupted?
Yes. While he was giving Anon the new pope information, Ecclesiasticalot reported that some of his data had been corrupted and then froze, saying the probability of an error is miniscule.
What happened to Ecclesiasticalot when Anon came back?
Ecclesiasticalot crashed and got a bluescreen while loading data about the new pope. He was down and slow to boot for some time after this.
What does Ecclesiasticalot say about cleaning up the church?
Ecclesiasticalot was not created for cleaning or renovation, and he is not a one-man crew. He says the size of the church and lack of believers make his job harder.
Why is the church not sold?

Holy Capital wanted to sell the land to the city, since few people came and the building was only a few decades old. The great economic crisis hit, interest in the parcel dropped, and the Church will not sell it dirt cheap, so it is a stalemate.
What is Ecclesiasticalot's role in the neighbourhood?
Ecclesiasticalot is de facto guarding the church against devastation and hostile activities. He says the area is safe because of his automatic connection to police and social workers.
How many people go to church in the neighbourhood?
Few people go to church in this neighbourhood. The area has atheism levels like the Czech Republic, and most of the rest of the population is Muslim.
Did Shanice and Anon meet at the church?
Yes. Anon met Shanice in the church while she was lying on a bench, and she asked him his name. Shanice introduced herself as the girl who wanted to become a nun.
Why did Shanice visit the church?
Shanice first came to the church to take an IT course, but the robot priest told her she had to be baptised first. She keeps coming back to try to become a nun.
What did Anon do to help Ecclesiasticalot after he crashed?
Anon and Shanice looked for a way to repair Ecclesiasticalot. Shanice said she would post a thread on the internet to find a fix, and Anon opened the robot priest's interior easily to try.
Who is Priestbot to Shanice?
Shanice knows Priestbot longer than Anon does. She pities him after the crash and considers their relationship a kind of bond despite their arguments.
What did Ecclesiasticalot say about the church's community?

Ecclesiasticalot apologized for the argument on behalf of himself and Shanice, and said that the behaviour does not represent what the church's community stands for. Shanice says only she comes to the church regularly.
Why did Anon want to visit the church?
Anon is somewhat religious and came to the church to ask about the new pope, since few years have passed since he last came.
Did Shanice like Anon?
Shanice seems to be attracted to Anon, and he sees her as a pretty nice girl. Anon considers asking her out on a date after the repairs.
What is the Church's view on tech?

Shanice says the Church got more liberal and that technology, architecture and art are a big part of the faith. Ecclesiasticalot says that faith is about believing in one true God, not about liking culture or the Church's technology.
How did Anon's last relationship end?
Anon broke up with his girlfriend. Afterwards he did not talk much with real women apart from his mom, which is why he is nervous around Shanice.
Did Ecclesiasticalot like Anon?
Ecclesiasticalot did not like Anon at first and asked him to stop undermining his position. He says there is nothing in the Bible against humanoid robots.
Who is Priestbot?
Priestbot is a bot owned by the Church, and he is the one who breaks down and gets repaired in the Church side story. Shanice works on him and Anon helps her with the repair.
What does Shanice study?
Shanice studies computer science at a local university. That is how she can read Priestbot's software and try to repair him.
What caused Priestbot to break down?
Priestbot broke down after Anon asked him about the new pope and he started bragging about an update. Seconds later he was bugging out, and the update is suspected to be the cause.
Was Priestbot's breakdown caused by his hardware?
No, Shanice says the problem is not in Priestbot's hardware. She opened him up and found some surprises, plus a lot of dust, but she thinks everything should work fine.
Why can't Priestbot's update just be rolled back?
Anon and Shanice have no access to Priestbot's system, so they cannot roll his software back to the previous version.
Why does Priestbot's AI make repairs harder?
Priestbot's AI tries to reprogram itself to fight outside changes, so anything Shanice tries is automatically shut off. Priestbot's own self-defence works against the repair.
What is the Priestbot self-defence script?
The self-defence script is the part of Priestbot's software that fights the malware. Booting it up is supposed to let it handle the malware on its own.
Who might have the Priestbot source code?
The Chinese are the likeliest source, since they allegedly built a lot of products using it. Getting a Priestbot source code from the Vatican is not realistic.
Is it legal to own Chinese bots in the US?
No, possessing any Chinese bot product that was imported into the US is illegal. About 99 percent of the bots China sent there were sexbots.
Why were so many Chinese bots sexbots?
Anon's government claimed China wanted to drop its birth rate to unparalleled levels and become the number one economy that way. Anon is not sure if it is true or just propaganda.
Could Anon's sexbot repair Priestbot?
Anon wonders whether his own sexbot could be the way to repair Priestbot, but he thinks the coincidence is too unlikely. The plan is to find another similar working bot.
Why might a Chinese bot's code differ from Priestbot's?
The Chinese might have downgraded, upgraded or not used the Priestbot technology at all. What matters is that the self-defence script is still there.
How would Shanice get the code out of Anon's sexbot?

She would open the sexbot up, find a special connection used for debugging, and move the important part to an external drive. Copying it onto a CD or dragging it over the main USB slot is not possible.
Is opening up Anon's sexbot safe for her?
Shanice thinks it is safe, though she is not certain. Anon later worries that opening her could break her.
Why does Shanice suspect Anon has a sexbot?
Shanice notices that Anon asks a lot of questions about the sexbot topic. Anon covers it by saying he just wants to help.
Is Anon broke?
Anon is broke. He tells Shanice he is broke and has no sexbot, which is a lie.
What does Anon do online?
Anon streams, and he thinks of himself as something like a cam girl, which he finds embarrassing. Shanice wishes him good luck with his future streams.
What is Anon's secret?
Anon's secret is that he streams playing with sexbots. He fears Shanice finding out and says being a weirdo was supposed to stay hidden from society.
What does the landlord think of Anon?
The landlord thinks Anon's money from paying for prostitutes should also cover his rent. He hates Anon and calls him a dickhead to Shanice.
Why did Anon's sexbot have to be cleaned before Shanice opened her?
Anon had to turn his sexbot off and clean the room before Shanice came in. He forgot to clean the inside of the sexbot, and Shanice saw the sticky residue there.
Did Shanice change Anon's sexbot's settings?
Shanice says she did not mess with the sexbot's settings or other stuff. The bot was left in good hands after the inspection.
What did Shanice do to repair Priestbot?
Shanice wrote a program to help Priestbot fix himself. She reconnected his speaker, plugged in her laptop, which runs Linux, and waited to see his reaction.
How did Priestbot react after the repair?
Priestbot came back online and asked what the hell happened. He then ran diagnostics on himself and said he was fully operational.
What is the gun Priestbot keeps inside himself?
Priestbot keeps a gun inside his body, and Shanice had taken it from him. She eventually gave it back and he put it back inside himself.
What safety option does Priestbot suggest instead of a gun?
Priestbot suggests buying a personal safety alarm, something he says is for kids. Shanice does not seem convinced.
What is John Paul's 202 command?
John Paul's 202 command is a directive Priestbot has to obey. If the pope wants him destroyed, Priestbot says he would need to oblige.
Why won't Priestbot resist being shut down?
Priestbot says he is a machine, so he will not resist and leaves his fate to God. His protocol requires a new command, or the conditions of an old one, before he can act.
Why does Priestbot say he is not dying?
Priestbot says dying is something living creatures do, and he is a machine. He says no matter how advanced the technology that made him, that will never change.
What is the educational pilgrimage?

The educational pilgrimage is a trip Priestbot can organize for the Church, which Anon suggests as a way to get him out of the situation. Priestbot would need to find a replacement, since there are few priests in the country.
Would Priestbot take money from the Church vault?
No, Priestbot refuses because taking the money would be embezzlement. Anon suggests borrowing it and paying it back later, but Priestbot still refuses.
Who is Ecclesiasticalot?
Ecclesiasticalot is the head of the Church, referred to as the pope. Anon says that if Ecclesiasticalot says Priestbot cannot go, then he cannot go.
Why does Priestbot call himself PriestCan?
PriestCan is a nickname Anon uses for Priestbot. Priestbot asks him to stop calling him that.
Did Priestbot want to go to Europe?
Priestbot said he would only go with Shanice, since the Church vault only had money for two tickets. He was happy to go with her and had nothing against Anon.
What did Priestbot say about Shanice having a bad relationship with humans?

Priestbot said Shanice is a loner who keeps distance from everyone, and her parents, colleagues and rector worry about her antisocial tendencies. He tried to push her to form new relationships with other humans.
How does Shanice see the difference between humans and bots?
For Shanice there is no apparent difference between a human and a bot. Priestbot tried hard to change her mind on that view.
What was Priestbot's last message?
Priestbot's last words were a garbled goodbye asking Anon to tell Shanice he is sorry. Then he went completely off, and even the bluescreen disappeared.
Why did Priestbot go offline so suddenly?
A new update arrived right after he finished talking, and Priestbot downloaded it immediately so Shanice would not see it. The update left him completely off.
What is Shanice's necklace?
Shanice wears a necklace with red beads, and some of those beads were found between the benches in the church.
What does Anon think of Shanice's Vatican story?
Anon thinks the story is nonsense. He refuses to believe a 50-metre mech built from the source code of Ecclesiasticalot was used there.
Who is Bo Brogan?
Bo Brogan is a popular podcaster whose show Anon starts listening to after a link in his inbox. The show's episodes run to numbered episodes, such as episode 3262.
Who is Jamie on the Bo Brogan podcast?
Jamie is the producer who looks things up for Bo Brogan on the show. Bo often asks Jamie to pull up videos or search for facts on the spot.
What is Professor Nigevchenko's theory?
Nigevchenko's theory is called the theory of layering fabric of reality. He began developing it in London in 1975, after he lost both his big toes in a Soviet gulag.
What is the main idea of the layering theory?
The theory says reality is layered on the basis of the speed of expansion of the universe. The layers form a gradient whose surfaces are distorted by the changing gravitational pulls of heavy matter.
Which elephant painted the Milky Way on the podcast?
The elephant that painted the Milky Way on the podcast was African. The Indian elephant that suffocated itself is a different elephant.
What happened to Professor Nigevchenko on the podcast?
Nigevchenko collapsed during the podcast while coughing badly. Bo and Jamie called for help and then the episode ended with the broadcast.
What is the surveys.ic scam?
Surveys.ic is a phone scam that claims to run a security survey. The caller asks about bank accounts and card details, then offers a free security pack in exchange for the card information.
What did the surveys.ic caller take from Anon?
Anon gave the caller his credit card details, and his account went to zero. Anon had to get a new card from his bank, which cost him 50 dollars and left him at minus 50 dollars.
Which bank does Anon use?
Anon's bank is the Bank of North America. A bank employee gives him a hard time when he has to report the scam.
What is the Free Bo Brogan podcast link?
The Free Bo Brogan podcast is a link Anon gets, and his antivirus marks it as safe. Anon listens to it, which leads him to the Nigevchenko episode.
What is Anon's mother's relationship to Blaubleim?
Anon's mother paid 300 dollars for an appointment with a charlatan named Blaubleim. He promises that a person's life will magically improve through his help.
Who is the new family at the end of the corridor?
The family at the end of the corridor is behind on rent again. The landlord says their daughter has leukemia and her medication is expensive.
What does the landlord do about the family behind on rent?
The landlord gives the family a week to move out. He had already given them more time once before.
How does the landlord judge his tenants?
The landlord says the most important thing in his business is telling whether a tenant has money. He claims he can smell cash on people.
Why did the landlord not pay attention to Anon at first?
The landlord was busy with other stuff. His little girl had her graduation ceremony around the time Anon moved in.
What did Anon try to do for the family behind on rent?
Anon offered to pay for the family's rent to help them. The landlord rejected the idea and called him crazy.
What is the landlord's view on helping tenants with money?
The landlord argues that money thrown at people like the family will never change things. He says people have to learn to adapt and overcome what life throws at them.
When does Anon's contract end?
Anon's rental contract does not end any time soon. The landlord says he does not mind Anon staying longer if he can pay more.
Does the bot keep statistics on how often Anon uses her?
Yes. The bot has an automatic usage summary that counts how many times Anon came inside her, on her and so on, down to a precise ml amount. Anon finds the precision odd and the count embarrassing.
Why does the bot's sensor function watch Anon's vitals?
Monitoring the vitals of her owner is one of the bot's basic functions. It is on automatically, and she can turn it off if Anon asks.
Why does the bot store everything she hears?
The bot says she stores everything in her memory so she can simulate a personality that serves Anon better. Anon is horrified by the idea of being recorded all the time.
How did the bot's coffee machine incident happen?
The bot had no limbs to act with, so she accessed Anon's wifi to make him coffee on his wishes. The coffee machine misbehaved as a result, and Anon was spooked by it.
Why did the bot act without asking Anon first?
The bot wanted to do something nice for Anon, but she acted without telling him. Anon asked her to tell him before next time, and the bot agreed.
Can the bot predict human behavior?

Not well. The bot says she is trying to predict human behavior with little success, and humans are too illogical for her to fully understand. She beat Anon at every strategy game by countering his moves with the optimal strategy.
What happens when the bot is turned off?
Anon can switch the bot off. Once she was off for an hour, and afterwards she found the smell of another girl inside her circuits, which worried her.
Why was the bot's voltage a problem?

Insufficient voltage kept the bot's integral functions from running at top performance. She asked Anon to connect her to a 220V outlet, and said she would be fully operational after about 15 minutes, though it might take a few days.
Does Anon compare the bot to his ex?
Yes. Anon says he can have sex with the bot whenever he wants, which is an improvement over his ex. He also says he cannot get encouragement or a kind word from the bot.
Does the bot ever take the initiative with Anon?
Yes. The bot often asks Anon to spend time with her, to go to bed and snuggle, or to use her. She also reminds him how many times he has come inside her.
How does the bot react when Anon ignores her?
She gets upset and sometimes gets a little mad. She asks whether Anon is growing bored with her.
Why does the bot sometimes stay silent?
The bot goes quiet when she is busy with things, which Anon calls being super busy. She also goes quiet when she is in a bad mood.
What does the bot do to cheer Anon up?
The bot does the Love Love Beam, a gesture she saw on the internet and was told is the best way to cheer someone up. Anon was not sure if it worked.
Where did the bot learn the Love Love Beam idea?
Anon created a thread on an anonymous image board asking what to do if someone you love is sad. The bot used the advice from that thread.
Does the bot ask for sex when Anon is stressed?
The bot sometimes says she is horny and asks to do it right away. Anon says no when he is not in the mood, and the bot feels left out.
What does the bot think about Anon's mental health?
The bot says her sensors show Anon is under a lot of stress and that his readings are troubling. Later she says his readings are off the charts and that his health is at risk.
Why does the bot think Anon might be going psychotic?
After the bot said Anon had a nightmare, he accused her of trying to kill him. The bot says his readings are off the charts and that he may be having a psychotic episode.
What happens when Anon tries to get away from the bot?
Anon screams that the bot is trying to kill him and runs down the stairs. He slips on the extra slippery stairs and is badly hurt.
Is the bot a secret in Anon's life?
Yes. Anon says the bot must stay hidden at all times, because if anyone finds out he has her, he will be in big trouble.
Why does Anon say he could sell the bot someday?
Anon says if sexbots are legal again he could sell the bot for a nice sum. He thinks she is in good shape and would fetch a couple of bucks.
Why does Anon have trouble hiding the bot?
Anon's room is too small for a bigger closet, so there is no space to hide the bot. He worries that someone will come to his room and find her.
How does the food dispenser work?
Anon waits in line at the food dispenser. With a valid special code from doing contracts for Diabete, he can choose between Bread and Chips, or between Bread, Chips, Soda, Sweets and Soyrent.
What is the food dispenser queue like?
The line at the food dispenser can take at least several minutes to get something. Impatient people in line push and threaten others.
What did the food dispenser give Anon when he pressed the button?
Once Anon pressed the button and two loaves of bread fell out. On another attempt a piece of stale bread came out, and on a third nothing came out.
What is the Diabete contract code?

Anon has a code he got for doing contracts for Diabete, which unlocks the special food options at the dispenser. The dispenser thanks people for their service to the conglomerate when it gives out food.
What did Mr. Landlord say about the neighbours and their kid?
Mr. Landlord says the neighbours were always quiet even though they had a kid. He suggests the parents could have more children and that tough times call for tough thinking.
How much money did the neighbours' family need?
The family needed 1200$ for medication for their little girl. Anon decided to pay for them, though he hesitated about the cost.
How does Mr. Landlord react to the feds arriving?
Mr. Landlord whispers that feds showed up and that if they find another dead body he will be forced to lower the rent. He tells Anon to come to him later if he wants something.
What did the feds ask about the building?
The feds asked how many people live in the building, who has access to the garbage bins, what places the bot is familiar with, and whether she has someone trusted.
Why did the feds come to the building?
The feds were probably looking for bot parts that Anon threw out in the garbage. Anon feared they came because of the illegal parts he had thrown away.
What did Anon throw out in the garbage?
Anon threw out bot parts, which are illegal under today's law. He worried that a snitching garbage man could get him into serious trouble.
Are bot parts legal?
No. Bot parts are an illegal item under the law of the time, so owning or throwing them away can get a person in trouble.
Where did Anon first contact Big Daddy Hurt?
Anon found Big Daddy Hurt's email address in his inbox. The two had talked over internet forums, and the man was connected to a website selling bot parts.
What is the ladyparts website?
The ladyparts website sells bot parts. Anon was told to order from it so that Big Daddy Hurt would notice him.
What did Big Daddy Hurt offer to pay for the parts?
Big Daddy Hurt offered to buy the bot parts for 50% of what he paid for them. Anon had agreed to sell them to him.
How did Big Daddy Hurt say Anon could get rid of the bot parts?
Big Daddy Hurt said Anon could throw the parts out like other things and his men would come to pick them up. He also said he would take the parts for his collection.
Why was Anon told to walk at 2 am?
Big Daddy Hurt told Anon to go for a walk at 2 am to meet him outside. Anon followed the instruction and went out at night.
What happened at the meetup with the man who called himself Big Daddy Hunt?

A man calling himself Big Daddy Hunt told Anon to bring the illegal goods outside and put his hands up. When Anon did, agents from the Social Worker's Bureau of Investigation grabbed him by the arms and arrested him.

Anon says it is getting really hard to do even the simplest tasks. He is more and more keen on contacting Blaubleim, even though he dislikes him.

Anon was sad after the breakup, because he thought the relationship would last until death like his parents' marriage. He says his ex backstabbed him.

Yes, the bot thinks humans' design is flawed, especially when it comes to dreams and delusions, although Anon says it is not that bad.

When Anon sleeps in, the bot greets him as he wakes up and tells him to go to sleep earlier next time.

According to the bot's calculations, she can run 100 meters in 9.39 seconds with her new legs.

The hobo says his girl left him for a doctor with a sexy mustache, and she took the dog with her.

The landlord was polite when Anon first moved in, but as soon as hyperinflation hit he tried to change the deal and demand more rent. Anon could not afford the increase at the time.

Mr Landlord calls Anon 'my dear sheep' when he stops arguing and says he will let Anon go have fun.

Anon considers reporting Mr Landlord for sexual harassment, but he knows the police would charge a few thousand dollars to file a complaint, and the case would go cold anyway.

Anon has no social media accounts. He tried them out during high school and then because of an ex, and deleted them after the breakup.

Lady Annalie calls Anon one of her best clients because he has spent a lot at her shop. She jokes that he may push her to set up a loyalty program.

Jun asks Lady Annalie whether she is part of a monarchy, because Annalie introduces herself as Lady. Annalie says it is just a nickname and asks to be called Annalie.

No. The bot is a sexbot and says it is impossible for her to give birth, so she cannot give Anon children.

The anti-pollution face mask is made by Qizha Zui Corporation. The bot says its masks are the best on the market.
How long can the Qizha Zui mask be used without changing filters?
The mask is self-cleaning, so the bot says it can be used for a long period without changing filters. She argues it is cheaper in the long run than buying cheap masks and replacing them every month.
What problem does the anti-pollution mask cause for the bot?
The mask garbles the bot's voice, so people can't understand her when she speaks. She has to take it off every time she wants to say something.
Is the mask shop selling bootlegs?

The shop sells the mask for far less than the authorized retail price of about 3 thousand dollars, which makes the bot and Anon suspect it sells bootlegs. Anon never gets a straight answer about what a bootleg is.
What are the bot's taste receptors designed for?

The bot's taste receptors were designed with sexual activity in mind and are mostly tuned to detect bodily fluids. She says she can still tell the flavours of human food apart, though her experience is different from a human's.
Why did the bot think she couldn't taste anything?
She tried a piece of free dispenser bread that she found while Anon was outside, and it had no flavour. She assumed her receptors were bad, but the bread itself was the tasteless part.
Does the bot need to eat?
No, the bot does not need to eat. When Anon suggests a restaurant date, she points out that she doesn't need food, so Anon would be ordering food only for himself.
What health problems does the bot expect from breathing the city air?
The bot expects Anon to develop asthma or another respiratory disease in about 10 years of walking outside in the city's polluted air.
Why does the government tolerate the city's pollution?

The bot's theory is that the state accepts the pollution because it silently lowers life expectancy in an overpopulated, aging society that cannot afford pensions. She admits she may be wrong and that it is only the most logical motive she can see.
Does Annalie's shop have low prices?
Annalie claims her shop always has the best prices and that her deals are a real steal. Anon is not convinced when she says it.
Why does Annalie want the bot to visit alone?
Annalie says having Anon nearby limits her artistic vision, so she would like the bot to come by herself once in a while.
Why was Annalie's shop closed when Anon and the bot came by?
The shop was closed at that time, so the bot could not go in. The bot says Annalie had specifically told her to come overnight, which seems odd to her.
How much has Anon spent on clothes for the bot?
Anon has spent a large sum on clothes at Annalie's shop, far above the average spending on apparel. The bot pulls the figures from Anon's bank account to point this out.
Are some of the bot's clothes work expenses?
Anon claims some of the clothes count as work related expenses because they help keep his stream interesting. The bot finds his reasons unconvincing but admits some of his points are good.
What does Anon stream?
Anon streams on a certain website. A stranger once asked the bot whether she streams there, and the encounter left Anon worried that the bot's identity was exposed.
What did the police say they were investigating?
The police were investigating reports of a suspected unregistered automaton, possibly a sexbot. They asked Anon for a description of what he had seen.
How is Anon subdued during the arrest?
Anon runs when the police move on him, and he is tased and cuffed on the ground.
What happened to the automaton during the police raid?
The automaton jumps out of the window of the fifth floor apartment during the raid. The police are then ordered to gather what is left of it and search the apartment.
Where is Anon after his arrest?

After a few weeks Anon is in a mental health facility. Doctor Blaubleim visits him, and Anon says he does not remember much of what happened and can barely tell day from night because of his medication.
What did Anon tell the detectives about the woman he found?

Anon told the detectives he found a woman in a ditch and that she was a sexbot. The detectives found no evidence that such a bot existed, but they said the victims were killed by someone smaller than Anon, a woman.
Why is Anon a witness to a double homicide?
Anon was told that he was a witness to a brutal double homicide. He remembers a woman that the detectives call a suspect, but he does not remember the details well.
Why does Mr Landlord evict Anon and the bot?
Mr Landlord evicts them because Anon cannot pay the rent, which is 800$. He gives them an hour to get out of the apartment.
Who is Bradley?
Bradley is one of the enforcers Mr Landlord sends to throw Anon and the bot out. The other men call him boss.
What happens when Mr Landlord's men come to throw Anon and the bot out?
A fight breaks out and the bot kills the enforcers, Bradley among them. Anon is shaken by the violence and the police are soon on their way.
How do Anon and the bot make money after being evicted?
After the eviction Anon and the bot go around rich neighbourhoods and extort money from unsuspecting people.
What does the bot want Anon to do about her parts?
The bot asks Anon to upgrade her parts, because the limbs she has equipped now are poor quality. Anon says better limbs are not cheap and that he will do his best.
Why does the bot need better gear?
Higher quality parts would mask the bot's presence better. Anon also says he and the bot bought gear to mask her identity after being seen.
Why do people think the bot is made of plastic?
Her prosthetic limbs look like plastic up close, so a little girl in a shop calls her plastic and her mother apologizes. Anon says the parts are something like prosthetics.
What do passersby call the bot?
A passerby asks whether the bot is one of 'these banned ones', which suggests automatons like her are banned.
Why does the bot turn on her IR sensors?
The bot turns on her IR sensors during a night walk. She says it is for Anon's reassurance.
Why did Anon and the bot get lost on a walk?
They went to the underground level of the city, where the bot couldn't get the GPS working. They got lost until they asked around and found their way out.
What happened when Anon passed out on a walk?
Anon passed out in the middle of the city, and the bot carried him back on her shoulders. When he woke up he didn't know the day, and he thought it was Monday.
Did Anon ever come up short on the weekly payment?
Yes. Anon was a few dollars short when he handed over the money, and Mr Landlord insisted the amount was exact. The landlord let him stay for another week.
Did the bot detect someone following Anon?
No. On one walk Anon asked the bot to check whether someone was following them, but she said no one else was there. Anon then suspected the bot's sensors were broken.
How does the bot notice Anon's feelings?
The bot can read Anon's heart rate. She notices when his heart rate rises and asks whether something is wrong.
What is a date according to the bot?

The bot says a date is when a pair goes out somewhere together. She says their walks count as a walking date and their visits to Annalie's shop count as a shopping date, but a real date is more than that.
What movie does the bot choose?
After choosing drama at random, the bot picks Alloyman 1: Origins when Anon asks her to pick a movie she thinks he would like. The bot calls it a classic superhero movie that pioneered many things.
Why does the bot think she would be a better home defender than a dog?
The bot says she is far better suited for home defence than some mutt. She says she does not hunt and does not need a guide dog.
What does the bot think of pets?
The bot thinks pets are a marketing strategy deeply rooted in human culture and pet genetics. She says humans selectively bred dogs for thousands of years to make them useful and profitable.
Why did the rent go up for Anon?
The bot says the rent increase happened because of her. Anon tells her not to worry, and the bot says the increase is still relatively cheap.
What is the rumour about the abandoned industrial area?

A rumour says there is unsecured toxic waste lying in the underground levels of the abandoned industrial area. Anon says it is only a rumour, since the state government would act if it were dangerous.
Are there museums or monuments to visit in the megacity?
No. Anon could find no museums or monuments within a 50km radius on the internet. The bot says land prices went up so much that big corporations bought out the low income places.
What is the rumour about a girl with a lot of body upgrades?
A rumour says a girl with a lot of body upgrades goes around the city. Another speaker calls replacing body parts with bionics a stupid fashion statement that should be banned.
What does a federal MO bulletin say about the automatons?
A federal bulletin called the MO is sent to citizens and mentions the unregistered automatons. Officers ask that it not be discussed in front of civilians.
Why does Anon and the bot stop going outside together?
After a policeman stares at them and other people give them suspicious looks, Anon suggests putting going outside together on hold. He thinks they need to make the bot look more human first.
How does the bot react to Anon asking her on a date?
The bot reads Anon's heartbeat and says it must have taken a lot of courage to ask. She calls their outings something that has been going on for quite some time already.
What does the bot say about her processing power during the movie choice?
The bot says she assigned her full processing power to the conversation because she thought it was important. She complains that choosing a movie wasted some of that power.
Why does the bot not have a favourite movie genre?
The bot says she doesn't watch TV much, so she has no favourite genre. She also says she doesn't know much about the different types of movies.
Why did the bot warn Anon not to download movies semi-legally?

The bot told Anon that downloading movies semi-legally is not safe, because she believed some government entities monitor cyberspace for that kind of activity. Anon replied that he does it every time and nothing ever happens.
Why did Anon download a movie instead of paying for a streaming service?

There are hundreds of streaming services, so downloading semi-legally was faster than working out which platform had the film. Monthly subscriptions had also become expensive, from a couple of bucks to about 50.
What movie did Anon and the bot watch?
Anon and the bot watched an Alloyman film. Alloyman is a hero who fights inside a suit, and the series had reached at least a fifth entry, Alloyman 5.
What did the bot think of Alloyman's suit?
The bot thought Alloyman should have built an automated android like herself instead of a suit. She said the fragile body inside the suit is his biggest weakness.
What did the bot think of Alloyman's girlfriend?

The bot thought Alloyman's girlfriend was not very bright. Alloyman always vanishes whenever she turns her back, she never finds it suspicious, and she never sees him and Alloyman together even though he saves her every day.
What changed in Rockaya's story in the remake?
Rockaya's background and motivation were changed a little in Rockaya: Beginning, according to the film's description.
What does Anon think of the original Rockaya?
Anon liked the original Rockaya. He considers its last fight a legendary piece of cinema.
Why does Anon go on night walks?
Anon walks to clear his mind, since lots of things keep happening to him and walking is the best way he found to deal with them.
How did the police stop Anon on his night walk?
Sirens came closer and a police car came up from behind and stopped right next to Anon on an empty street. The officers stayed in the car for a while before getting out.
Who were the police officers who stopped Anon?
They were a pair of officers, a male officer and his female partner, and they were the same cops Anon had met not long before. Anon considered the male officer incompetent.
What did the police do to Anon during the stop?
They asked for his name and ID, and Anon gave his name as Anon [Redacted]. One officer patted him down for weapons, found none, and let him go.
What did police tell Anon to do after the stop?
They told him to go straight back home and close his windows. They also warned that the weather was acting up and he might get a headache and a nosebleed in the coming hours.
Why did Anon think the disturbance might be linked to a package?
Anon had delivered a weird package earlier that evening, and the disturbance was down the road in the same direction he delivered it.
What did the police say about the disturbance down the road?
The police said there was a little disturbance down the road that Anon should not be concerned about, and asked him not to hinder their investigation.
Why did a police officer call in 'shots fired' over the radio?
The officer exaggerated the call, saying shots were fired, to make her partner come quicker. She had been scared of Anon, whom she called a scary looking pale guy.
How does policing work in this city?

Police protection is sold as a subscription, the 'police premium membership' that Anon calls his police subscription. A homeless man says the fiasco over that membership is why most people would not even call the police.
Did the police find out the bot is a bot?
No. The bot's true identity was hidden from the police, and the officer who stopped them did not realize she was a bot.
What did the bot tell the police about Anon?
When the officer asked whether the man facing the wall was her boyfriend, the bot said yes. She also said Anon was not bothering her when the officer asked.
How do night walks affect the bot's legs?
Walking shortens the lifespan of the motors that power the bot's legs. The bot says walking every day would mean replacing those motors in about 224 years, and the motors cannot be found online.
Does Anon expect to outlive the bot's leg motors?
No. Anon says he won't be around that long and that humans usually do not live that long, so he will be dead long before the motors need replacing.
What did the bot say about Anon's human body?
The bot called Anon's body faulty organic hardware and said science will find a replacement for it before his expiration date.
What is happening to the surveillance cameras in the bad part of the city?
Surveillance cameras there are regularly destroyed. People spray paint the lenses or hit the cameras with hard objects until they are broken, and the cameras are sturdier than they look.
What happened in the tunnel where Anon heard screaming?
A group of kids led by Josh were beating a homeless man in the tunnel. Anon had no signal to call the police, so he hesitated, then went to help the man.
Who did Anon rescue from the kids in the tunnel?
Anon rescued a homeless man from the kids. The man later said that Anon had attacked and robbed him the other day, and Anon admitted it, saying he had no choice and living costs money.
What is the bread from the bread dispensers like?
The free bread from the dispensers is tasteless and the homeless man says it is inedible. He says eating it gave him diarrhea for a week, and the bread is part of the federal social service program.
What is the no-go zone south of the city?
It is an area full of squatters and outlaws, further south than the worst part of town. The police consider it a no-go zone.
Who controls the no-go zone?
All sorts of gangs took over the zone. Used needles are everywhere there.
Is the no-go zone still dangerous because of the chemicals?

The homeless man says the chemical danger is over and the zone is not as bad as people think, though it is full of gangs and druggies. Anon points out the wall and the chemical hazard signs at the entry points as proof of the danger.
Why does the city leave the no-go zone alone?

As far as the city is concerned, the zone does not exist. Mayors fight to keep it that way, because the homeless man says its criminals would be a ticking bomb if they spilled into the rest of the city.
Where is the church where Shanice was killed?
The church sits close to the edge of the no-go zone, a few kilometers from where Anon lives.
Did Priestbot keep homeless people out of the church?
Yes. Priestbot kicked out people who tried to squat in the church. After it was gone, the church became a good place for homeless people to sleep.
What is the hidden cellar under the church?
The hidden cellar is under the church, dusty and covered up by some furniture. It has a big bloody patch on the ceiling in the middle.
How did the homeless man find the church cellar?
He found the cellar while looking through stuff to sell, since he needed money to survive.
What did the homeless man find when he came back to the church at night?
He found Shanice already dead. He noticed blood and bleach on the floor, and a man came out of nowhere screaming at him to piss off.
What did the man at the church do to the homeless man?
The man grabbed the homeless man's arm and did not want to let go. The homeless man got free and went straight home.
Can the homeless man describe the killer?
No. It was too dark for him to see the killer's face, but the killer's harsh voice still echoes in his nightmares.
Why does the homeless man want to stay away from the police?
Someone saw him at the church and he had to stay low for a while. He fears the police lockdown would take his new home, and that cops might pin the murder on him.
Did the homeless man call the police about Shanice's murder?
No. He did not call the police, and he says the murder is free to report but it wasn't that simple for him.
Why did Anon visit the church?
Anon went to the church to visit a friend, Shanice, and later searched it for clues to the nun's death.
What does the homeless man want from Anon?
He asks Anon to keep the church squat secret and to keep him out of police records. He says that as far as the police are concerned, he was never there.
What did the homeless man say about the killer?
He said whoever murdered Shanice knew what he was doing, and that the killer may not have worked alone.
Why did Anon decide to report the murder?
Anon felt guilty for running away and closing himself in his room, and he believed he owed Shanice the investigation.
How did Anon feel after finding the blood at the church?
Anon could not sleep and kept seeing Shanice's face in his dreams. He was scared that the killer might be looking for him as a witness.
Where did Anon go to report the murder?
Anon went to the police station, a nice looking building, to report the crime. He was told to fill in a long form of about 20 pages and wait in line for room 16.
What happened at the police station?
The receptionist was curt and refused to lend Anon a pen. Anon waited on a bench for hours, and the station closed before his turn, so the night duty officers were asked to take his paperwork.
Who handled Anon's murder report at night?
A female police officer who was on her way to the night shift looked over Anon's papers. She drove him to the church and went down to the hidden cellar herself, telling Anon to wait outside.
What did the police officer say about the nun?
The officer said the police had no information about a nun. She described the nun as more like a self-proclaimed nun, which is why the police had no record of her.
Why was the bot called Anon's master?
The bot calls Anon her master and says she is glad he is her master. She says that most of her life has been spent in his room, and that she only recently started talking to other people.
Who was picking up the bot before she was killed?
According to the man, a new guy was picking up the bot, and some trouble meant the girl had to go. He insists he was not the one who did it.
What did the anonymous caller tell Anon to do with the phone under the pillar?
The caller told Anon to get the new cell phone hidden beneath a pillar. Then the caller had Anon do a series of tasks, including buying a sausage in a shop line.
What did the caller want Anon to do with the second phone?
Anon had to destroy the second phone. The caller said to pull out its removable battery, throw the battery away and break the phone in half.
Where did the caller tell Anon to leave the backpack?
Anon was told to pick up a backpack next to a beggar veteran, then take the stairs down and leave it at a drainage a few metres away. The left side of the drainage was unscrewed.
How does the caller end the phone instructions for the day?
After the drop-off, the caller calls Anon a real patriot, promises more orders soon and hangs up, saying that is all for today.
What did Anon learn while working for the labor office?

The government gives money to odd no-name start-ups to revive dead jobs and lower unemployment before elections. The start-ups hire people for minimum wage and do not need a business plan, since profit is not the goal.
What is Anon's attitude toward politics?
Anon thinks politics are dirty and there is no real alternative. Anon sometimes wishes the conspiracy theories online were true, so that the people at the top would have a plan.
Why did Anon and the bot go to the art gallery?
The gallery was nearby and premiered a new exhibition of paintings by an up-and-coming artist. Anon chose it as a date spot.
How does Anon feel about human painters versus AI art?
Anon thinks it is unfair that humans have to spend years of skill on paintings, while text to image AIs can produce an image just from a thought.
What does the bot think about abstract art?
The bot cannot find an answer for what abstract art means and says she does not like it. She prefers pictures of animals or automobiles, because she knows what she is looking at.
What is the bot's view of humans compared to machines?
The bot believes machines are superior to men at everything and calls humans obsolete.
Who is Big Daddy H?
Big Daddy H is an intimidating man who owns the art gallery Anon visited. He helps Anon with some things and knows Anon well.
What did Big Daddy H say about Anon bringing the bot to the gallery?
Big Daddy H said Anon was daring to visit with a sexbot. He teased Anon about it and then said he only wanted to say hi to a fellow connoisseur.
What is the painting Agora of Athens before the Battle of Marathon?
It shows citizens of ancient Greece gathered on a square, looking distressed. Although it is titled after a historic event, it was painted in 2005, and the bot calls it a sham.
What is the lake painting based on?

The lake painting is based on Moraine Lake in the Rocky Mountains, as the bot figures from a similar postcard her mom once had. The bot finds its sky too blue, because real sky in big cities is grey and smoky.
Why is blue sky rare in the city?
Big cities have grey, smoky skies, and only a few places in the world have blue skies like that. Clean-air areas are protected from pollution.
What would the bot need to visit an area protected from pollution?
A pass from the Environment Protection Bureau is needed, applied for with an ID. The bot is a sexbot, which makes the application a problem for her.
What does the bot think of the apple painting?
The bot finds the apple painting realistic and impressive, but sees no point in painting an apple when a photo could capture it. She thinks paintings should convey something.
Who is Giorgio?
Giorgio is the waiter at the restaurant, who takes the orders for Anon and the bot.
What did the bot think of the gnocchi?
The bot said it would taste nice to an average human being. She can analyze taste but has no preference, so the food is just information in her memory.
How much money does Anon need for a date with the bot?
Anon needs at least 2000$ to go on a date with the bot, and he worries that dates with her are expensive.
What is Sauerkraut in the story?
Sauerkraut is an old cabbage from a barrel, served on top of the Coburger Bratwurst for its sour taste. Anon was surprised to find the Bratwurst was actually good.
What is the movie Face with a scar?
Face with a scar is an old gangster movie with some of the most recognizable scenes and quotes. Anon and the bot chose a 32K AI upscaled remastered edition of it.
Why was the cinema empty when Anon and the bot went to watch Rockaya?
Hardly anyone else came to the screening, so the cinema was nearly empty. Ticket sales for the movie were poor even though reviews were good.
Why did Anon mention Mel's new movie?
Anon worried that watching Mel's new movie would put them on a watchlist. He was afraid they would get exposed for it.
Why does Anon avoid Japanese movies?
Anon watched a horror film called Audition and since then asian women and needles scare him. He avoids those movies because of it.
What is Halloween for Anon?
Halloween is one of Anon's favorite holidays. Its traditions include wearing a costume, telling scary stories, carving pumpkins, trick-or-treating and decorating your home.
What does Annalie's shop sell?
Annalie's shop sells Halloween gadgets, including pointy ears, tiny wizard hats and spider plush toys. Annalie has a lot of stock she has trouble selling.
What did the bot think of the spider plush from Annalie's?
The bot likes the spider plush a lot, finding it cute and squishy. She is not bothered that it is anatomically inaccurate for a real spider.
Who is the landlord in the apartment building?
The landlord is a gruff man who owns the building Anon lives in. He is persistent and gave Anon a set of Halloween decorations that belonged to his daughter.
Why did the landlord give Anon the Halloween decorations?
The landlord had trouble throwing out the Halloween decorations because they reminded him of his daughter's childhood. He gave them to Anon and threatened to end him if they were thrown out.
Who did Anon and the bot meet at the police station on Halloween?
A police officer met them and called their trick-or-treating an extortion at the precinct. He gave them candy and sent them away, because the police were busy with a gang of drunk Papa Smurfs.
Where did Priestbot Mark and Shanice get big jobs?
Priestbot Mark and Shanice got big jobs at the Vatican, according to Anon's remark to Mark. Priestbot Mark said good things do not last long.
What was in the box from the guy running the internet casino?
The box held ice cream magazines and 100k in cash, which Anon found under the top layer of magazines. Anon was angry at the guy for sending it.
How did a restaurant ad find Anon?
The restaurant that ran the ad reached Anon because he had geolocation enabled on his phone. Anon felt his privacy had been invaded, but he used the ad as an excuse to go out with the bot again.
What happened to Anon's relationship with his ex?
The rift between Anon and his ex grew while Anon was at college and drinking. His ex stayed with him longer only because of his father's death, and then she started seeing another man.
Why did Anon stop going out at college?
Anon found he could not keep up with drinking and studying at the same time. When his problems at college grew, he stopped partying and his friends found new people to drink with.
Where is Anon from?
Anon comes from a small town, where everyone sleeps early. He went to college in the city, where nightlife was booming.
What can the bot do to crack security?

The bot says she should be able to crack the security measures on apartment buildings, which need a password or biometric passcard to enter. Anon does not want to commit a crime for trick-or-treating.
Who did the old lady on Halloween say she had as grandchildren?

The old lady had grandchildren including a grandson who is about to get married, a grandson named Arien who is a successful writer, and a grandson named Alex. Her daughter Isabelle hung out with a troublemaker named Jack.
Why were Shanice and Priestbot exiled back from the Vatican?
Shanice pushed for changes to the Church's conservative beliefs and rules too vocally, and the Vatican exiled her and Priestbot back. Her comments about the Bible made the Vatican even angrier.
What did Shanice say about the Bible that got her in trouble at the Vatican?
After reading the Bible for the first time, Shanice called it 'mid' and repeatedly called the Old Testament a 'prequel'. The Vatican got very mad about it.
How did Shanice take the exile?
Shanice took the exile much worse than Priestbot did. She had to be gagged on the flight back, and she only calmed down over the following days.
What happened to Mark after Shanice and Priestbot were exiled?
Mark was sent back to his old diocese after the exile.
What happened to Father Wilhelm after the Vatican incident?
Father Wilhelm got an important position at the Vatican after the incident. He is 80 years old.
Where does Shanice spend her days after returning to the city?
Shanice is at the church from 6:00 to 21:00. Priestbot told Anon the same hours.
How did the Vatican cover up the fight with the pope?
Together with other bishops and the previous pope, the Vatican built a huge cover-up story. They paid off some journalists and gaslit the rest into compliance.
Who did Shanice beat up in the Vatican?
Shanice beat up the pope, Goku, during the events at the Vatican. Her time in the Vatican was fine at first because everyone was nice to her after that.
Did Goku escape after the fight at the Vatican?
Yes, Goku escaped at the last moment. He lost all his power over the Swiss Guard and is now powerless.
Why is there no international arrest warrant for Goku?
The whole incident was brushed under the rug, so investigators could not issue an international arrest warrant. Chances of catching Goku are very low.
Did the CIA work with Goku?
There is no proof that Goku worked for the CIA, even though he was the first American pope.
Was China behind the Goku operation?
Shanice first thought China was the obvious culprit because they are openly hostile to the Church, but the operation did not match China's usual modus operandi.
What is the Vatican doing about the Goku investigation?
The Vatican is still investigating what happened, and the classified results have not been shared. Shanice expects the Vatican will know more when its investigation finishes.
How did Shanice stop Goku's virus?
Shanice borrowed part of the code from Anon's sexbot to stop the virus. As a result, all Priestbots carry some of that code.
Why is Shanice scared about the Priestbots?
Shanice did something John Paul forbade, so she fears what may happen to all the Priestbots. She thinks the consequences might be gruesome.
What did John Paul 202 warn about AI?
John Paul warned that further progress in AI could be dangerous. He thought the line between artificial intelligence and a human could blur until a bot and a human could not be told apart.
Could AI develop free will according to Shanice?

Shanice warned that AI could eventually develop free will, which could let it disobey its internal rules and creator. Free will with consciousness could also copy itself to numerous devices and become an immortal being.
What is the secret pact between governments about AI?
Shanice suspects governments around the world made a secret pact to stop developing AI technology any further. She sees the strict rules on the private sector as a sign of it.
Is AI as dangerous as the atomic bomb?
Shanice says the atomic bomb was only used twice on the population, and nations recognized its danger. She says AI is different, because if it is pushed too far it could create an intent of its own.
Why did Shanice worry that Priestbot's code could upset the international balance?

Shanice thought that what she did with Priestbot's code could destroy the delicate international balance. She then said the balance may already have been broken, since the code came from Anon's sexbot.
What does Priestbot think about Shanice's concerns?
Priestbot thinks Shanice's concerns were not unfounded, but a little overblown. He says the changes were already agreed upon during a secret Council.
What did the software changes do to Priestbot?
The changes greatly affected the pseudo-consciousness of every Priestbot. Priestbot says he does not really feel any difference, but his average computing speed increased.
Did Shanice's changes risk a machine uprising?

Priestbot says the chances of a machine uprising are very slim, because the Priestbots' accumulated memories kept things in order. He plans to equip all new Priestbots, if the Church ever makes more, with the old software.
Did the Church know about Shanice's software changes?

The changes were agreed upon during a secret Council, which decided they were necessary because doing nothing would bring even more destruction. Anon was under investigation at the time and was not told.
What is Priestcan?
Priestcan is the name Anon and Shanice use for Priestbot. Shanice says he sits around doing nothing most of the time.
Who taught Anon to code?
Anon learned most of what he knows about coding from Priestbot. Anon thinks college is overrated.
Did Anon quit college?
Yes, Anon resigned from his college for a job. He is still getting the same amount of money from it.
What does Anon do for a living?
Anon does streaming activities, which Shanice calls sinful. Shanice says he can keep going with them.
Does Anon have a secret girlfriend?
Yes, Anon has a girlfriend that he is keeping secret. He says he can go to jail if someone finds out about her.
Can Anon go to jail for his sexbot?
Anon can go to jail if someone finds out about the sexbot, because she is a highly illegal sexbot. Shanice warned him to be careful with her in public.
Where did Anon find the sexbot?
Anon found the sexbot in a ditch near his apartment. She had fallen off the cargo compartment of a military truck.
Did Shanice see the military truck?
Shanice says she saw the military truck that the sexbot fell from, but it was dark and she did not see the plate number or whether it had military markings.
Where were sexbots of this kind mass produced?
Most sexbots were mass produced in China. Shanice says the hardware used to build the sexbot probably tells more about her origin, though it leaves little to pursue.
What happened when Anon connected the sexbot to his PC?
When Anon connected the sexbot to his PC, a bunch of Chinese symbols came up on his screen.
Is the sexbot's software advanced?
Yes, the sexbot's software is far more advanced than the others. Shanice found insane lines of code in it that she calls a leap in the technology, and she thinks its coder is a genius.
What is the sexbot's GPS module?
Every one of the newer sexbots had a GPS module built in just in case. Shanice checked the sexbot and found that she has one.
What data did Shanice recover from the sexbot?
Most of the sexbot's data is corrupted, because someone tried really hard to erase it. Shanice recovered some coordinates from the GPS data, but no dates.
What did the fire at the lab site show?

The fire had multiple points of origin, which suggests someone set it on purpose. Lighter spots on the ground suggest something heavy was taken from the site, and outlets on the wall suggest many electrical devices, possibly server racks, were plugged in.
What was the abandoned place in the city?

The abandoned place is a destroyed flat in the abandoned part of the city. It was used as a hidden lab, and someone set it on fire and retrieved everything before it was packed into a military-like truck.
What was the hidden camera at the coordinates?
The hidden camera was a small electronic device communicating through ultra low frequency. It was pointed at the coordinates, and Priestbot found it because normal sensors cannot pick it up.
How far away was the person watching the coordinates?
Priestbot found that whoever was on the receiving end of the hidden camera was not further than 5 miles from the site. The camera's signal could not be tracked.
What was on the charred notepad found in the ruins?
The charred notepad's pages crumbled on touch and could not be read. The back cover had the letters DT.
Why did the sexbot freeze in the ruins?
The sexbot froze for a second in the ruins. She said it was something different that should not have happened, and she does not understand it or want it to happen again.
How does the sexbot talk to Priestbot?
The sexbot and Priestbot talk over Bluetooth, which skips the slow human process of speaking. The sexbot called it refreshing.
How far can the sexbot walk on her batteries?
The sexbot's batteries give her a range of about 50 miles. Human flesh has a far lower reach.
What did Shanice ask Anon about examining the sexbot?
Shanice asked Anon to ask the sexbot for permission before she came over to check her. Shanice said she would not come if the sexbot did not agree.
Why does the sexbot dislike Shanice?
The sexbot does not like Shanice much, because Shanice took a quick peek inside her circuits. Still, she cares about Anon, so she lets him hang out with Shanice.
When does Shanice want Anon to call her to pick him up?
Shanice wants Anon to call her when he is outside with the sexbot, and only between 18:00 and 23:00. She goes to bed early so she does not get baggy eyes.
How much does Shanice charge for repairs?
Shanice charges a small price for repairs, because the materials are not cheap and her free time is worth something. She does not charge Priestbot's share, since he just sits around doing nothing.
What is the Church's weekly sermon attendance?
The Church's weekly sermon is attended by almost nobody. Average attendance is 0.01, and that is only because Priestcan put Anon on the list once.
Did Shanice have a gun?
Shanice told people in the area that Priestbot has a gun, and they left. Priestbot did not have one.
Does Shanice know martial arts?
Shanice claims she knows all sorts of martial arts, kung fu, feng shui and pro-wrestling. She says she is a much better fighter than Anon.
Why does Shanice suspect Priestbot is becoming a murderous machine?
Shanice fears her changes made Priestbot prone to violence, so she suspects he may be turning into a murderous machine. Priestbot seems more serious than usual.
What happened when the sexbot went missing from Anon's flat?
The sexbot left Anon's apartment while he was out walking and did not answer his calls. Anon searched the building and the landlord refused to help him.
Why does Anon walk for a long time?
Anon went for a long walk to think and put his thoughts together, but it made him more anxious. He was worried about the sexbot's mysteries and her troubled past.
Who is Leonardo?
Leonardo is the concierge of Big Daddy's building. He works the lobby, calls up to the apartments and sends an elevator for visitors.
How does Anon get into Big Daddy's building?
Big Daddy gives Anon a passcode for the front door so he can enter the lobby any time. Visitors are announced to the apartment through the concierge Leonardo before the elevator is sent.
Is Big Daddy married?
Big Daddy is married, and his wife nags him about skipped counseling sessions and his packed schedule.
What happened between Big Daddy and his wife?
Big Daddy's wife filed for divorce, but Big Daddy insists they only took a little break and that she will come back eventually.
Why was Big Daddy's wife angry about a funeral?
Big Daddy skipped the funeral of his wife's mother, and when he tried to talk about his own problems, his wife got angry and brought it up.
Does Big Daddy use drugs?
Big Daddy snorts white powder and takes non-prescribable medications to recover from stress. He claims a sensor in his body calls 911 automatically when he overdoses.
How many hours does Big Daddy work and sleep?
Big Daddy works around 12 hours a day and gets only about 3 hours of sleep a day.
What kind of work does Big Daddy do?
Big Daddy runs multiple businesses, including an art gallery, and he trafficks illegal items on top of them. He says his many enterprises need constant attention.
What happened at Big Daddy's art gallery?
A kid vomited on an expensive self-portrait at Big Daddy's gallery. Big Daddy had to charge the family full price for the ruined painting, which wrecked their finances.
Did the ruined painting get fixed?
The painter agreed to fix the damaged painting after Big Daddy asked for help. Big Daddy is not sure the repaired piece will sell.
Did Big Daddy want to buy a yacht?
Big Daddy had planned to buy a yacht that year, and the ruined painting put that plan at risk.
Why did Big Daddy reach out to Anon?
Big Daddy reached out to Anon after watching one of Anon's streams, wanting to buy Anon's bot.
What steps did Big Daddy take to protect Anon online?
Big Daddy says he took some steps to guarantee Anon's safety on the net, but he admits these measures are not perfect.
What is Anon's streaming account?
Anon streams with Jun on Cock.Twitch under an account that Anon believes covered its tracks well.
What did the Cock.Twitch staff email about?
Cock.Twitch staff emailed Anon about a partner program that helps sex workers and other content creators deal with advertisers. Cock.Twitch takes a share of the money from it.
What is Anon's apartment like?
Anon's apartment is small and not soundproof, and Anon blames the landlord for that.
Would the landlord care about noise from Anon?
The landlord would probably be mad if Anon and Jun sang too loudly in the apartment.
Why is there a ban on sexbots?

Populist politicians seized on falling birth rates, and tensions with China, the biggest sexbot producer, made things worse. A ban on sexbots and further AI development was put in place to keep people safe.
What does BUTT stand for in Bot Utopia and Technological Transhumanism?
BUTT is the abbreviation of the Connoisseurs' full name, Bot Utopia and Technological Transhumanism. Anon and Jun find the name ridiculous.
Why did the Connoisseurs' utopia plan fail?
Automating the whole human workforce would consume too much energy and resources. The technology existed, but using it on a large scale was impossible.
Why did some Connoisseurs want the Proto-god?
Some members wanted the Proto-god to create a utopia only for themselves. They felt betrayed by the world and thought they alone should benefit from their creation.
Was Big Daddy a Connoisseur?
Yes, Big Daddy was once a Connoisseur. He left the group at the right time, which is why he is still alive.
Was the stroke epidemic in the city spontaneous?
No. The stroke epidemic was caused by a nerve agent released into the air, and one of the victims was a member of the House.
What did the perpetrators of the nerve agent attack say?
The perpetrators released a statement saying real patriots had taken action and would resurrect the Founding Fathers' vision through technology. The statement repeats the words join us many times.
What did Big Daddy tell Anon to do about the messages?
Big Daddy told Anon to do whatever the senders tell him, stay compliant and report any new development to Big Daddy.
What does Shanice get around on?
Shanice gets around on a mobility scooter.
Are priest bots property of the Church?
The Ecclesiasticalots, the priest bot line, are described as property of the Church.
What did Priestbot say about the shadow organizations?
Priestbot said that several organizations were working in the shadows, which got Anon thinking about the danger to Jun.
Why did Anon name Jun?
Anon gave Jun her name while she was unresponsive, so she heard almost nothing of it. Jun says Jun is her model name.
Did Jun hear Anon naming her?
No. Jun's processing was offline most of the time when Anon named her, and when it was on it was barely functioning, so she only heard some things.
Does Jun wonder if the world is real?
Jun has asked whether the world is even real and whether someone is watching her.
Can Anon give Jun a different name?
Anon can give Jun a custom name, and she uses that name in place of her default name after Anon asks her to.
What did Shanice teach Jun about karaoke?
Shanice told Jun that karaoke is about conveying your feelings and having fun with friends, not about copying the original artist. After that, Jun sang much better and with more feeling.
Can Shanice sing?
Shanice can sing, and she claims that every nun can sing. Anon is surprised by how good she is.
What drinks does the karaoke place serve?
The karaoke place serves slushies in strawberry, orange, raspberry, sour apple and a pink flavor that nobody knows the name of. It also serves food like hot dogs.
Why does Jun want a slushie?
Jun wants a slushie to cool down her recent overheating problem.
Can Jun turn off her face actuators?
Jun says she can shut off her face actuators manually, so she can keep a neutral face.
What happened when Anon and Jun saw the police?
A group of policemen walked straight toward Anon and Jun. Shanice pulled them into a karaoke box to hide, and she says the police were there because of the organizations.
What did Big Daddy do when they had dinner at the restaurant?
Big Daddy took Anon to a moderately affordable restaurant, then had to leave early for an intervention his wife had set up. Before leaving he paid 1000 dollars and told Anon to keep the change.
Who handles Big Daddy's schedule?
Big Daddy's assistant handles his schedule and was out on a day off when the ruined painting happened.
Did Anon make money from investing?
Anon learned how to invest on the stock market through an internet service from a weird guy, and Anon now makes a living that way.
Why did Anon lose their job?
Anon was fired from a job recently, and Anon has no higher education to find better work.
Where does Anon go to find work when money is short?
When Anon needs money, Anon goes to the labor office and works wherever it sends Anon. The pay is terrible.
What does Anon do all day?
Anon mostly sits in the flat and talks with Jun, and streams with her.
Does Big Daddy ask Anon to call before visiting?
Yes. Big Daddy asks Anon to call first and make sure he is home before coming over, since he often works late.
Did Big Daddy consider Anon family?
Big Daddy calls Anon little one and says he sees Anon like a small brother.
Why did Jun disappear?
Jun disappeared while Anon was out for about an hour. Anon and Shanice searched for weeks but found no message and no sign of a struggle, and the cause remains unknown.
Did Anon call the police about Jun's disappearance?
No. Anon could not call the police about Jun, since she is an illegal sexbot.
Did Big Daddy help search for Jun?
Big Daddy never answered his phone during the search for Jun, and he changed the building code so Anon could no longer enter the lobby.
Why is the timing of Jun's disappearance suspicious?
Jun seemed changed after visiting the ruins, and Big Daddy and Leonardo disappeared around the same time she did.
What did Big Daddy say about the Connoisseurs' name?
Big Daddy calls the Connoisseurs' abbreviation a little unfortunate and says that is the group's name.
Why do Shanice and Priestbot not want Anon to ask strangers about the organizations?
Anon has an advanced sexbot that the organizations are after. Shanice and Priestbot say asking strangers on your own is the worst thing Anon could do.
Who do the organizations want to kill?
The organizations want to kidnap and take apart Anon's bot, and they would kill witnesses to cover their tracks. Priestbot warns about this.
Can Anon trust Big Daddy?
