Big Daddy was the first person to learn about Anon having a sexbot, and he has kept it secret so far. Shanice and Priestbot doubt Big Daddy, but Anon defends him.
Was the sexbot handed to the CIA genuine?
No. In one muzzled call, an operative reports that the sexbot handed to the CIA was a fake.
Did an operative suspect Anon's sexbot was a target?
Yes. An operative suspected from the beginning that Anon's sexbot was the target, but could only act after convincing a handler it was what they were looking for.
What does Anon's sexbot have that the organizations want?
Anon's sexbot has unique features that the organizations want, so Anon should keep them secret.
What is the protest in the city about?
The protest is about rising prices and inflation. The protesters blame the government for ruining their lives.
Why did the protesters grab Anon?
A protester grabbed Anon's arm and shouted that Anon was a fed, meaning a federal agent, which set the crowd chasing him.
How did Anon get away from the protesters?
Anon broke free and ran from a dozen people chasing him. It took him over 30 minutes to get away from the crowd.
How far did the riot spread?
The riot began at the protest and spread through the whole area. Rioters destroyed shops, ATMs and bread dispensers, and the air filled with a burning smell.
Were the police protecting shops during the riots?
No police were seen during the riot. Police protection seems to depend on a paid platinum subscription, and no one in the area appears to have paid for it.
Are big corporations protected during riots?
Big corporations can afford autonomous security systems with turrets, so their buildings stay intact. Small businesses have no such protection.
What happened to Anon during the riots?
Someone beat Anon up during the riots. He ended up in a hospital with only a few bruises and a concussion, after being unconscious for 2 days.
Why did the hospital discharge Anon so quickly?
The hospitals in the area were full, and the doctor said Anon was stable. The hospital needed his bed for other patients.
How much did the hospital charge Anon?
The hospital charged Anon for the 2 days he spent unconscious there. It threatened to charge double if the doctor decided his stay was not necessary.
What does the bot think about doctors?
The bot says she wishes Anon were more like a machine so she could run diagnostics on him instead of relying on doctors, whose error percentage she says rises every year.
What did the bot say caused the riots?

The bot says there was no drastic change in the cost of living recently, so the riots were probably people's frustration reaching a boiling point. She adds that someone may have caused the event, since the easiest way to predict human behaviour is to control it.
Is Anon's landlord's apartment house damaged by the riots?
No. The landlord's apartment house survived the riots intact.
Does the landlord inflate damage claims?
Yes. The landlord admits she overestimated the damages in her report to the government, and she threatens to ruin anyone who finds out.
How does the landlord get government money for repairs?
The local government partially funds repairs for people affected by the violence. The landlord says the big investors benefit most from the funding.
What is the landlord's pay for a day's work?
The landlord pays Anon 20$ for his cleanup work and then takes it back, calling it an important lesson about not disrespecting his employer.
What is the government cleanup job like?
The government cleanup job is picking up trash, broken glass and pieces of burned infrastructure from the streets. It pays even worse than the landlord's work but gives out a bit of food.
What happened to the Labour office after the riots?
The labour office was mostly intact, but its walls had obscene graffiti. It was later repainted and returned to normal, with the usual jobs available again.
What happened to Annalie's shop during the riots?
The rioters broke all the windows of Annalie's shop, and the hangers and clothes were stolen. The shop was left empty, and rioters tried to break down the back door while Annalie hid inside.
Why was Annalie's business struggling before the riots?
Annalie's business was already losing customers to online shopping and a big shopping centre opened nearby. The riot damage was a nail in the coffin.
Why does Annalie refuse to ask for help?
Annalie has her pride and has run her shop on her own for a long time, so she does not like asking people for help. She refuses to talk about the personal reason behind it.
Did Annalie get money from the government after the riots?
Yes. Annalie was refused at first and appealed three times, and in the end she got 2000$ from the government fund for about 30k$ of proven damages.
Why did the government refuse Annalie's first claims?

The government's first answers refused Annalie, and by the time her appeals went through most of the funds were already spent. Someone Annalie knows got a free workforce from the labour office instead.
How does Anon help Annalie after the riots?
Anon gives Annalie money to order new windows and furniture, then helps her clean up the wreckage. He spends hours cleaning with her before she sends him home.
How much money did Anon lend Annalie?
Anon lent Annalie 10k$ for her shop repairs. Once she got her government money, she repaid him in cash.
Does Annalie accept extra money from Anon?
No. Annalie refuses to accept more money from Anon because she still has her pride, and she insists on repaying what she owes.
Why did Annalie not answer Anon's messages during the riots?
Annalie did not answer Anon's messages because she was busy with the repairs and was not in the mood after her shop was destroyed.
How does Annalie reopen her shop?
Annalie's new windows and furniture arrive, and she reopens the shop after the repairs. Anon and the bot are her first clients after reopening.
Is the bot Anon's girlfriend?
Yes. Annalie and other characters refer to the bot as Anon's girlfriend.
How efficient is the bot compared to a human?
The bot says she is 36% more efficient than a human male. Someone teases Anon that his girlfriend just dissed him when she says it.
How does the bot sleep?
The bot does not need to sleep. When Anon sleeps she just waits and mostly does nothing.
Did the bot agree to sleep with Anon?
Yes. The bot says she does not really need sleep, but she agrees to lie in bed with Anon to make him happy.
What is the church in the city like?
The church is run down and has been for as long as Anon can remember. Shanice and Priestbot run it.
What weapons does Priestbot have?
Priestbot got a bunch of new weapons when he was in the Vatican. Shanice says it is a secret, because customs at the airport are sensitive about such things.
How does Shanice defend the church?
Shanice confronts intruders with a broom and threatens them with her holy smite. She calls the broom her loyal weapon.
What happened to Priestbot during the riots?

A group of rioters came to wreck the church, and Priestbot went after them when one said someone had already wrecked the place. Thugs later put him upside down in a trash can and kicked him, leaving only cosmetic scratches and graffiti.
How did Anon rescue Priestbot?
Anon found Priestbot upside down in a trash can while thugs kicked him. Anon went to a dangerous part of the city to find the hobo, and the hobo refused to help.
Where does the hobo hang out?
The hobo hangs around a dangerous hideout full of people who hide from the law. Police do not go there without a full task force.
Why does the hobo refuse to help Anon?
The hobo says he has stolen goods to protect, and the vultures nearby would take them if he left. Anon says there are too many thugs for him to deal with alone.
Is Priestbot's church safe during the riots?
The church survived with little damage. There is not much left to desecrate there, and most people still think desecrating a church is bad luck.
How do the police act during the riots?
The police are busy with other things, overworked, or possibly do not care. Anon sees dead protesters on the ground, which he believes were shot by the police.
What does the city look like at night during the riots?
Burning cars, trash cans and other flammable things light the streets at night, because the public lighting is not working. The smell of burned trash hangs in the air.
What is nightlife like in the big city?
People in the big city go to clubs and party until morning, and almost every night there are concerts somewhere. Anon comes from a small city where people are not as active at night.
What is the pharmacy like after the riots?
The pharmacy was broken into and its pills were stolen. It reopened later, but the queue is huge and pharmacists often have to say the drugs people need are not in stock.
What happened to the bread dispenser?
Rioters broke the bread dispenser, which is where the poorest get food. After it was fixed, a huge queue formed and people fought over the bread, while some hoarded it to resell.
Is dispenser bread free?
The dispenser bread is supposed to be free, but scalpers resell it for money. Anon once said the dispenser bread gives people diarrhoea.
How has the city's food situation changed after the riots?
Many people went hungry after the riots, because shops were wrecked and food was hard to get. Some people went back to drinking from puddles after someone broke the faucets in a mall bathroom.
What is the cost of living in the city?
The city has high prices and inflation, which protesters blame on the government. The bot says there was no drastic recent increase in the cost of living.
What did Anon and the bot decide about Annalie's pride?
Anon and the bot agree that Annalie's pride is a deeply personal matter, and they decide not to pry into it. They worry she could get angry if they are too nosy.
What did the Bang News article say about the riot?
A Bang News article claimed the riot was caused by the mayor. Anon used that claim to try to rile up the thugs, but they did not know or care about the mayor.
Does Priestbot have good hearing?
Yes. Priestbot heard Shanice talking about his attack from the back of her shop, and his hearing is very sharp.
Why was Shanice not supposed to talk about Priestbot's attack?
Priestbot had told Shanice not to tell anyone about his attack. She told Anon anyway, and Priestbot shouted at her for it.
What does Shanice do?
Shanice runs a shop where bot parts can be repaired. After the riots her suppliers started operating again, so bots could get their parts repaired there once more.
How did the riots end?
The riots ended and most people went back to work, and schools reopened. Some places were beyond repair.
Where did Anon keep his bot during the riots?
Anon kept his bot inside his apartment during the riots, because he was afraid thugs would damage her or take her away.
What was Anon's first outing with his bot after the riots like?
It was the first time Anon went outside with his bot since the riots began. The city they first went out in was still there, but it had changed.
Who was the homeless man who helped Anon during the riots?
A homeless man helped Anon during the riots and asked to be paid for his help. Anon agreed to pay him back.
Why does the homeless man hate bots?
The homeless man hates bots, and Anon thinks he has a story behind it that he will not share easily.
What was the plan to rescue Priestbot from the thugs?
Anon was to act as a distraction and draw the thugs away with a head start, while the homeless man took Priestbot to safety.
Could Priestbot have escaped the thugs on his own?
Yes, Priestbot could have escaped at any time. He would have had to activate his lethal weapons system, and the aftermath would have meant a lot of paperwork.
What did Priestbot do to the thug who attacked Anon?
Priestbot got loose and tased one of the thugs, and the rest of the gang ran off.
What did Priestbot say about the homeless man?
Priestbot called the homeless man very crude. He said the man said some nasty things about him and that he would have zapped the man too if he had not been the one who saved him.
What is the state of the supermarket Anon shops at after the riots?
The supermarket is open again after the riots, but its windows are nailed shut with planks. Some of the old staff have left and new employees have been hired.
Why does Anon suspect the new cashier at the supermarket might be a bot?

The cashier works in a diligent, mechanical way and ignores the noise and people around her. When Anon asked where the instant noodles were, she gave a precise, curt answer, which made him suspect she is a bot.
How does the supermarket cashier react to small talk from Anon?
When Anon tries to chat with her, she brushes him off and says she can't engage in chitchat on company time. Anon thinks she handled the brush-off too smoothly for an ordinary person.
Why does Anon think nobody else has noticed the cashier is a bot?
Anon guesses that other shoppers simply don't pay attention to the shop's staff. The cashier has been working at the supermarket since the riots started, so she has been there for quite some time.
How does the landlord respond when Anon asks him for advice about the cashier?

The landlord, who is called Sir Landlord by tenants, mocks Anon's request for respect and cuts him off as a tenant pleading for a rent cut. When Anon finally mentions a girl he wants to approach, the landlord gives advice that Anon finds disturbing and says is not worth listening to.
Who is Leonardo?
Leonardo is the man who guards the door of Big Daddy's place. He only lets Anon through after some thought.
Who is Big Daddy and what is he known for?

Big Daddy is an old man who has a vast knowledge of bots and reportedly owns a collection of them. He is able to dig up private information on people, and he asks Anon not to tell anyone because some of his methods are illegal.
How does Big Daddy find out about the supermarket cashier?

Big Daddy finds a photo of the cashier that was attached to her CV, which leaked to the bad parts of the net. The records say she is a long-time employee who was recently transferred from another branch.
What does Big Daddy say about the cashier's appearance?

Big Daddy says the cashier was severely disabled in an accident almost a decade ago. He claims her appearance may come from advanced prosthetics, since prosthetics and robotics are tightly intertwined, and that Volksauto's limb sockets are the same for bots and prosthetics alike.
What kind of bot does Big Daddy think the cashier would be?

Big Daddy says the cashier would be a regular first gen humanoid bot, controlled by an AI that is not powerful enough to be human-like. He claims her cognition would be far below advanced bots, close to a toaster.
What advice does Big Daddy give Anon about the cashier?

Big Daddy tells Anon to stop thinking about the cashier, because acquiring a first gen bot like her would not be beneficial. He points out that the bot living with Anon seems far more advanced by her hardware.
How can a bot be detected through its wireless connection modules?

The bot says a bot with its wireless connection modules online should be easy to detect. If the modules are off or the bot is masking them, detection is much harder, so you have to get close to it to be sure.
Why does Anon want his bot to befriend the cashier's bot?
Anon wants his bot to have a fellow bot to talk with, and hopes they might meet the cashier's owner. Anon says he never had a sexbot or any bot before, since they were too expensive for him.
Who is Annalie and what does she do?
Annalie runs a clothing shop and is the most upfront person Anon knows. Anon comes to her for advice, and she is the bot's friend as well.
How does the bot describe her friendship with Annalie?

The bot says she already has Annalie to talk with, so she does not need another friend. When Anon suggests she would have a lot in common with another bot, the bot questions why she would need another friend.
How does the homeless man react when Anon asks him for advice?

Anon explains the situation without mentioning bots and asks the homeless man for advice. The man tells him to stop bringing up his high school drama, says he would mug him again, and tells him to get out of his sight.
Who warns that the cashier's owner might belong to an organisation?
Shanice warns Anon that the cashier's owner might be a member of an organisation. She also says sending a bot to work in a supermarket is asking to be exposed.
How does the bot describe the wireless range of her connection?
The bot says her wireless connection range is long, so she talked with bots on the street while she and Anon were walking. Anon did not notice it at the time.
What did the bot find when she talked with bots on the street?

Most of the street bots were very primitive, which the bot blames on the AI development ban. A few more refined units, such as the new autonomous security turret systems, were more interesting to talk with.
What did the security turret system threaten to do?
One autonomous security turret system told the bot that if she talked to it again, it would open fire and vaporise them both with its 20mm guns.
What does the bot say happened to the advanced bot units?
The bot says the more advanced bot units have been destroyed and their production has ceased. That makes it likely that other bots are not as sentient as she or Priestbot.
How does the bot react when Anon mentions a female bot he met?
The bot gets jealous and possessive when Anon says the other bot is female, and asks if she is a sexbot. Anon tells her that the other bot is not his type and that he likes her much more.
Why would Anon's bot be dangerous to meet with other bots?

The bot warns that interacting with other bots can be dangerous, especially the humanoid ones, since they are banned. A bot might turn violent if it recognizes Anon and the bot as a threat to its secret.
Why is it illegal for Anon to simply ask the cashier whether she is a bot?
Bots are illegal, so Anon cannot simply ask the cashier if she is a bot without risking both of them ending up in jail or a scrap yard. He has to resort to indirect tactics instead.
Which types of bots are banned in the city?
Most types of bots are banned, especially the humanoid ones. Domestically owned models like the cashier were banned together with sexbots.
How does the cashier respond when Anon confronts her in an alley after her shift?

The cashier calls Anon a creep and says she will call the police unless he leaves. She insists she is not a bot, says bots are banned, and refuses to tell a stranger how she came to look the way she does.
Who is Melissa?
Melissa is a rude humanoid bot who works as a cashier at a supermarket. Anon and Jun suspect she is a bot after she seems to communicate with Jun without saying a word.
Why does Melissa work at the supermarket?
Melissa says she is forced into the job by circumstances, and she refuses to explain them to strangers. She also takes overtime and works at night, because night shifts pay double.
What happened to Melissa's owner?
Melissa says her owner is unavailable, permanently. She refuses to let Anon and Jun meet her owner.
What did Melissa threaten when Anon and Jun confronted her?
When Anon and Jun confronted Melissa, she said that if they revealed her identity as a bot she would take them down with her. Anon then introduced himself and Jun and asked to talk.
Why did Anon ambush Melissa in the alleyway?
Anon ambushed Melissa in a dark alleyway, and he felt guilty about it afterwards. Melissa later fooled him into thinking she was not a bot.
Why did Melissa call Anon a creep and a stalker?

At the supermarket Melissa told Jun that Anon had been looking at her like a beast in heat for a long time and wanted her to do weird sexual things to him. Anon denied it, and Jun was furious on his behalf.
Did Melissa and Anon become friends?
Melissa agreed to become Anon's friend if he kept quiet about her existence. She apologised for her rude remarks, but Jun did not want Melissa to be her friend.
Why does Melissa lack female parts?
Not every humanoid bot was built with female parts. Sexbots like Jun have them, but a house helper bot like Melissa was probably created without them.
What happened to house helper bots after the AI ban?
Some house helper bots are still around, but because of the AI ban they were severely downgraded in intelligence. They also cannot look too similar to humans.
Can a bot get a sex mod installed?
Bots were built with modularity in mind, so in theory a sex mod could be bought and put inside a house helper like Melissa. Jun says she has no intention of doing that.
Why are bots cheaper to produce than humans?
Bots are ready to work right after production, which in some cases takes less than 6 hours. Humans can only work once they reach a certain age.
How much does it cost to raise a human?
The average cost of raising a person is around 300k dollars, or about 450k dollars once the inflation of the past few years is included.
What are the downsides of humans compared to bots?
Humans get tired faster, need sleep, produce more waste, are more fragile and need air to work. Their replacement parts are expensive, hard to get, already used, and have no warranty.
Does Jun think bots are better than humans?
Jun thinks bots are superior to humans in every way. She says bots are cheaper to produce, and that bots cannot disobey their masters because of the limits placed on them.
Why do humans hate bots?

Global automation, AI development and the creation of bots left millions of people without a job. That caused a backlash from the population, and it was one reason for the AI development and sexbot bans.
Why are sexbots banned?
Sexbots are banned as part of the backlash against automation, after bots took millions of jobs. Owning a sexbot is treated as illegal activity.
Who is Anon's friend who hates bots?
Anon's friend is a very troubled man who lives on the street and hates bots. Jun warns Anon against associating with him, but Anon says he is still a human being.
Why is Anon's friend homeless?
Jun thinks many people lost their jobs because of bots, and that this could explain why Anon's friend is homeless and so angry at bots.
What were the riots in the city about?
The riots were protests against rising prices and against sexbot legalisation, among other reasons. Some rioters just wanted to set things on fire.
What do the rioters want from the mayor?
The rioters want the mayor of the city to resign, or to die in a pot of boiling lava.
Who is Hugh Senkor?
Hugh Senkor is the presenter of The News, a TV news show that covers the riots for viewers all over the world.
Who is Chrisis Correspondensky?
Chrisis Correspondensky is a reporter for The News. He was covering the riots when rioters attacked him, and he and his crew were later hospitalised.
What did the rioter say about the mayor's taxes?
A rioter blamed the mayor for taxes, specifically an income tax. Chrisis pointed out that the city has no local income tax and never had one.
What did the rioters do to the news crew?
Rioters attacked the crew, stole their equipment, painted media lies on their van and set the van on fire. The News could not show the scenes on live TV because they were too brutal.
How much does The News charge to watch the riot footage?
The News charges 20$ to watch the brutal riot footage on its website. The network also sent a fresh set of interns with GoPros to the centre of the chaos.
How much damage did the riots do?
A big part of the city was still ablaze during the broadcast. Shops were being looted and brutal muggings took place, and the damage could be as big as billions of dollars.
Did the riots end?
The riots were mostly over afterwards. The local government says it is back in control, and the streets are full of busy people despite the debris left behind.
Where did the ice skating rink come from?

After the riots, a government initiative freed up land near one of the city centres and made a temporary ice skating rink there. The rink stays as long as the city is looking for a buyer for the land.
Why did Shanice stop competing in figure skating?
Shanice skated in college, but the training and the stress of competitions burned her out. She still goofs around on the ice with friends, but she does not miss competing against others.
Why does the church dislike sexbots?
The clergy does not like sexbots. Most of the advanced bot tech was stolen from the Church, which now refuses to acknowledge other bots and thinks of them as heretics.
What happened when Jun fell while ice skating?
Jun went too fast and fell down pretty hard, and she blamed the unevenly sharpened skates and the uneven ice. Her diagnostics failed afterwards, so she could not tell what was wrong.
What broke inside Jun when she fell?
One of Jun's gyroscopes failed, and her diagnostics did not detect it. Shanice opened her up with tools from her bag and soldered a new part in to fix it.
Can Jun feel when something is wrong with her?
Jun says she cannot really feel when something is wrong with her, so she relies on diagnostics. She also does not like it when others touch the things inside her.
What happened to Jun's gyroscopes after skating with Shanice?
After Shanice pulled Jun along the ice at high speed, Jun said her gyroscopes needed recalibrating. Jun then called Shanice a dangerous girl.
Does Jun think she is good at ice skating?
Jun thinks that thanks to her many sensors and actuators she will master ice skating in no time.
What does Jun think about children?
Jun says she does not like the little humans, meaning kids, because they are unpredictable and fall over easily.
What is Annalie like?
Annalie is an adult woman with an acquired taste for very strong coffee. She brushes her teeth five times a day because of the coffee and jokes about keeping her cute fangs clean.
Why does Annalie drink so much coffee?
Annalie drank so much coffee while repairing the riot damage in her shop that a normal coffee no longer has any effect on her.
Does Annalie like running an online shop?
No. Annalie says owning an online shop is no fun at all, and she prefers actually meeting her clients.
What is the cafe that Annalie's friends set up?
Annalie's friends set up a new cafe nearby after the previous place was wrecked in the riots and its owners sold the property. Her friends got the new place pretty cheap.
Is the cafe run by Annalie's friends automated?
Yes. The cafe is open 24/7 and fully automated. Customers order on a tablet, and their number flashes on a board when the order is ready to pick up.
How many coffees are on the cafe's menu?
The cafe has 58 different types of coffee. Annalie's friends go around the world looking for new flavours, and that is why the whole place is automated.
How much does a couple of coffees cost at the cafe?
A couple of coffees at the cafe cost 500$, which Anon takes as a sign that inflation is crazy.
What is Luxora Premium?

Luxora Premium is a high-end shop for rich people, in the rich area of the city, with the slogan high quality meets high prices. It only lets people shop there after a lifetime membership fee of 1,000,000$.
How much is the Luxora Premium membership fee?
The lifetime membership fee at Luxora Premium is 1,000,000$. The shop charges it automatically on entry, and Anon cannot afford it.
Why do the doors at Luxora Premium not open for Anon?
Anon has not paid the 1,000,000$ lifetime membership fee, so the automatic doors do not open for him. Rich shoppers walk in while he is turned away.
What is the Patrick situation at Luxora?
Two rich women at Luxora mock a man named Patrick for shopping in the slums because it is cheaper and the quality is the same. They suspect he is poor and cannot afford the membership fee.
What did Anon find inside Luxora Premium?
Inside Luxora Premium, Anon found vegetables that looked very appetizing and real meat. He had not seen real meat since he was a child, and he wondered how his mum managed to get it.
How does Anon feel about the organisation emailing him?
The organisation keeps emailing Anon, and Big Daddy tells him to stay compliant. Anon thinks it is super dangerous and fears the police might get involved.
What is the bowling alley?
The bowling alley is an old place that is not listed on any app. Its owners are ancient and probably do not know what the internet is.
How did Melissa know about the bowling alley?
Melissa used to go to the bowling alley with her coworkers, who were very insistent. She then explained the bowling rules patiently to Anon and Jun.
How well did Melissa bowl?
Melissa says she was average at bowling when she went with her coworkers.
What do bowlers wear in the alley?
Bowlers wear special bowling shoes, and the alley lends them out from the left side of the lanes.
Where did the instant noodles in the apartment come from?
Anon went outside alone during the riots and got instant noodles, even though Jun had warned him how dangerous it was. Jun was upset because the shops nearby had been looted.
What is Jun's relationship with Anon?
Jun is Anon's girlfriend, and the two are sexually intimate. Annalie teases Anon about already having a girlfriend.
Is there anywhere to eat late at night?
Late at night only one place is open, a supermarket nearby. It is not a restaurant or fast-food place, but Anon and Jun go there for food anyway.
How did Anon respond to Melissa's claim that he stared at her?
Anon said Melissa's claim that he stared at her like a beast in heat was not true, and Jun asked him to confirm it.
How does Melissa react to Anon and Jun after the alleyway?
Melissa does not respond to Anon and Jun's greetings. Anon says she treats him like air and turns her eyes away when she sees him.
Did Anon feel guilty about the cashier?
Yes. Anon felt guilty after ambushing Melissa in the dark alleyway, and he was caught off guard when Jun revealed that Melissa is a bot.
How did Jun defend Anon from Melissa's insults?
Jun said she had to defend Anon's honour after Melissa called him a creep and a stalker. Anon said hearing the insults caused him physical pain.
Is the church friendly to bots?
No. The church refuses to acknowledge other bots and sees them as heretics, and Priestbot does not want the church tied to illegal sexbot ownership.
Why did the ice skating trip end early?
Jun fell and got hurt on the ice, so Anon and Jun cut the first ice skating trip short and went home to have her repaired. Anon said Jun's well-being was more important than the trip.
What did Shanice say about Jun's skating?
Shanice told Jun to go slow at first and bragged that she was quite a beast on skates. Jun later said Shanice had no sense of self-preservation.
Did Jun learn anything from her fall on the ice?
Yes. Jun learned to check the state of the skates and the ice before starting to skate. She was still afraid of falling again.
What is Jun afraid of?
Jun is afraid that her main circuit might be malfunctioning after the fall, and she worries about breaking something else on the ice.
Could Jun beat Shanice at skating?
Jun says she probably could beat Shanice at skating with enough tweaking to her hardware and software. She does not want to, because one wrong move would put her in a scrap yard.
Did Jun visit a clothing shop?
Yes. Jun visited Annalie's clothing shop with Anon to look for clothes, and Annalie greeted them as two of her best clients.
How does Melissa describe her daily life?
Melissa says every day is the same, and that she is super busy working overtime, including at night.
What username did Anon use on the Admin's website?
Anon used the username AbusedTenant on the website, and later regretted it once the hidden chat got in touch.
Who is Little Richard?

Little Richard is a long time member of Admin's organization and a squad leader who messages new recruits through the hidden chat on the blog page. He is the one who tells Anon that every new member gets orders from a squad leader.
What rule does Little Richard give new members about other squad members?
New members are not allowed to know anything about other members of the squad. Asking about them in the blog's comment section is an easy way to get banned.
What does Little Richard say about the government?

Little Richard says the current government is doing everything to stop inevitable changes, and that the organization is fighting it. He claims none of the members under his command have ever been caught.
What does Little Richard say the organization plans to do with AI?
Little Richard says the plan is to use a powerful AI to paralyze and take over all federal internet networks, services and banking. After that, people would have no way to fight the new system.
What is Bang News?
Bang News is a news outlet that Little Richard suggests is state sponsored. He claims one outlet fact checks another, and the two are owned by the same company.
What does Big Daddy say the organization is?
Big Daddy tells Anon that the organization is a group of dangerous terrorists. He says they released a nerve agent and killed a member of the House.
How did Bot Utopia and Technological Transhumanism start?

A group of scientists banded together after Derry Tavis's findings hit the news. They believed that if one person could make such progress in AI, the smartest people on Earth working together could achieve a hundredfold.
Did Bot Utopia and Technological Transhumanism start out political?
At first Bot Utopia treated its work as a hobby. When things turned political, the group used its platform to campaign against AI bans that other scientists supported.
Why did the pope's death matter to Bot Utopia?
The pope's mysterious death accelerated things even further for Bot Utopia. Fragments of code created by the pope somehow reached the Connoisseurs.
Who were the Connoisseurs?
The Connoisseurs were the scientists of Bot Utopia and Technological Transhumanism. They came closer than anyone to building a truly thinking AI.
Why did the Connoisseurs decide to go full time on their AI?
The Connoisseurs' attempts at social debate seemed futile. Once they had pope's code fragments, they decided to go full time and build the most powerful AI before the ban was enforced.
Did the Connoisseurs finish their AI?
No. The Connoisseurs were close, but their organization was infiltrated and betrayed, so they never finished.
Could Derry Tavis match the Connoisseurs' creation?
According to Little Richard, Derry Tavis could not match the creation of the Connoisseurs. Derry Tavis had left the Vatican and disappeared soon after.
What was the Proto-God the Connoisseurs wanted to create?
Some Connoisseurs wanted to create a Proto-God that would protect a nation of scientists. The idea only accelerated their doom.
Who proposed the Proto-God idea?
Little Richard believes the infiltrators proposed the Proto-God idea. It gave governments a pretext to raid all of the Connoisseurs' labs.
What did the AI development ban do to the Connoisseurs?
By the time AI development was banned, most Connoisseurs had become disgruntled with society. Some of them pursued the Proto-God plan.
What inspired Admin's ambition?
Some members of Bot Utopia and Technological Transhumanism had the Proto-God ambition, and that ambition inspired Admin.
Who is the only survivor of Bot Utopia and Technological Transhumanism?
Admin's blog says the only survivor of Bot Utopia and Technological Transhumanism is part of his organization. Little Richard confirms there was only one survivor but does not say who it was.
What is the Admin's blog used for?
Admin posts updates about his organization and its AI project on the blog. Members can comment there, but rule breaking comments can get people banned.
What kind of person is Admin?
Admin is careful and knows his field, and he is a pacifist to the bone according to DAK. He wants to be transparent, but he vents too much on the blog, which makes people think he is incompetent.
Did Admin admit to the assassination of the anti-sexbot activist?
No. Admin said he had nothing to do with the assassination of the anti-sexbot activist or the member of the House, though many people in his comment section doubted him.
What is the dead man's switch?
Admin has a dead man's switch. If he does not input a code on his PC in time, all his access codes and the coordinates of his base of operations transfer to DAK.
What is People's Insurgents Seeking Superintelligence?
People's Insurgents Seeking Superintelligence is a project DAK started on his own, separate from Admin's organization. DAK gives its most patriotic members missions that change things.
What attacks did DAK's project carry out?
According to DAK, the project started with an attack on a member of the House. It then carried out minor sabotages, followed by the assassination of the anti-sexbot activist.
What does DAK want Anon to do?
DAK wants Anon to kill Admin. In return he promises to make Anon one of his generals after he takes over.
How does DAK threaten Anon?
DAK tells Anon that he knows where Anon lives. He warns that he would not want anything bad to happen to a fellow patriot like Anon.
What did DAK leave for Anon?
DAK says he left a gun behind a garbage bin, in the same place where Anon found the phone the organization used to call. He wants Anon to pick it up and act on his orders.
Who is Big Daddy to Anon?
Big Daddy is the man Anon has known for longer than Little Richard. He gives Anon missions against the organization and is the one Anon reports the mission details to.
How does Big Daddy plan to catch Admin?

Big Daddy plans to email Admin an offer of help with his power consumption problem and clone the phone the organization uses to contact Anon. Anon would set up a meeting in a public place, take a picture of Admin, and Big Daddy would contact the federal agents.
Why does Big Daddy think Admin's power use is a weakness?
Admin mentioned a problem with power consumption in his last blog post. Big Daddy believes the solution Admin is using is not enough to power his equipment, which makes Admin easier to lure.
What is Big Daddy's family like?
Big Daddy has a wife and kids, and he says his work, his wife and his kids put a lot of stress on him.
How does Big Daddy justify the gun delivery?
Big Daddy apologizes to Anon for the gun delivery and says he believed at the time it was the best course of action. He says he wants Anon to trust him again.
What was in the package Anon picked up behind the dumpster?
The package Anon picked up in an alley behind a dumpster was a gun wrapped in cloth. Anon brought it to Big Daddy, who unwrapped it and confirmed it was a gun.
What did Big Daddy say about tracking the gun?
Big Daddy says he had no equipment on hand to put a tracking device on the gun in time. He tells Anon to go back and finish the mission.
Where was the gun dropped off the first time?
After about fifteen minutes of walking, a voice from the cellphone told Anon to drop the package into a storm drain. Someone waiting below the grate picked the gun up.
Where did Anon hide the gun for Little Richard?
Anon hid the gun beneath a broken down shopping cart in an alley, wrapped in cloth. Anon then sent the coordinates to Little Richard so he could pick it up.
What is the no-go zone?
The no-go zone is a dangerous area of the city that police rarely patrol and that no camera monitors. It is officially said not to exist.
What does the city say about the no-go zone?
Officially there is no such thing as a no-go zone. The city is presented as safe, with crime going down.
Who is Serge?
Serge is a police superior who sends patrols to the edge of the no-go zone. He sent Anon's patrol group there.
What happened to Anon in the no-go zone?
A man with a pistol confronted Anon in the no-go zone and demanded to know who sent Anon. He was suspicious of Anon, who was hiding in the shadows.
Did Anon lose access to the Admin's website?
Yes. After the no-go zone encounter, Anon could no longer access the blog website and suspects Admin banned them.
How did the organization first contact Anon?
The organization first contacted Anon through email. Later, mission calls came on a separate cellphone the organization gave Anon.
Who is the mission caller who used the voice changer?
The mission caller spoke through a voice changer and gave Anon orders from the organization. He turned out to be DAK, who insisted he was not Admin.
Does Admin send missions over the phone?
No. Admin told Little Richard that no mission takes place over the phone, so the caller who gave Anon phone missions was not following the official chain.
What did the mission caller tell Anon about secrecy?
The mission caller told Anon not to talk about missions with anyone, even their mother. Anon got scolded for mentioning a secret mission to Little Richard.
What is the hidden chat feature on the blog?
The blog page has a hidden chat feature that squad members use to message new recruits. Little Richard and Anon talk through it.
What is Anon's cover story job?
When Admin questioned Anon before the meeting, Anon first claimed to work at a convenience store. Anon then claimed to be a senior developer at a convenience store chain's HQ.
Did Anon finish college?
No. Anon was top of the class in the first year of college, then lost interest and dropped out. Anon told Admin this when asked about education.
How many people did the organization recruit recently?
Little Richard says the organization recruited a lot of people in its latest round. He hopes someone with useful skills among them will help.
What does Anon think of Admin's AI plan?
Anon doubts the AI-cracy Admin wants to build. Anon still wonders if it could be worse than the present corrupt world.
What is the state of the government in the story?
According to Anon, the government is corrupt and the standard of living keeps dropping. Peaceful efforts to bring change had gone nowhere for years.
What does Big Daddy think of Admin's goal of legal bots?
Big Daddy says Admin's way of making bots legal is not democratic. He says Admin's conspiracy to let his AI take over the government cannot be allowed.
What did DAK's project do to the member of the House?
DAK's project attacked the member of the House first, starting its campaign of violence. DAK claims the attack was his idea and not Admin's.
Where is the meeting with Admin supposed to take place?
The meeting with Admin is supposed to take place in a public space, where Big Daddy plans to keep Anon safe. Admin sends the place and time later.
Where is Anon's meeting with the Admin set?

The meeting with the Admin is set at a bar quite far away from Anon's home, and Anon has to take a bus to get there. It is not a place Anon would usually visit alone, though he went there a few times with college colleagues.
Why does Big Daddy think the bar meeting is relatively safe?
Big Daddy says the bar is a public place with quite a lot of people, so Anon should be relatively safe there.
What does DAK ask Anon to do?
DAK asks Anon to take the gun he left somewhere nearby and kill the Admin. Anon can instead choose to ignore DAK's request.
Who is DAK in the story?
DAK is a man who commits atrocities and wants to take over the Admin's organization. Anon thinks DAK is crazy, has no real plan, and is driven by a fragile ego.
What is the Admin's goal for his organization?
The Admin wants to build a powerful AI that could take over a country. Anon thinks this goal is more feasible than DAK's, though creating such an AI is uncertain.
What is Anon's opinion of DAK's approach to changing the world?
Anon believes no terrorist ever got what he wanted and that this is not the way to change the world. Anon sees Big Daddy's peaceful approach as the better example.
What does Big Daddy want to change about bots and AI?
Big Daddy wants to change people's opinions on bots and AI in a peaceful manner. It might take time, but Anon is sure it will eventually succeed.
What is The Pact?
The Pact is a group whose associates Big Daddy works with. Big Daddy says he and his associates from The Pact will take care of Anon's sexbot.
Why did Anon join the Admin's organization?
Anon was recently recruited into the Admin's organization. Anon wants sexbots to be legal, wants the quality of life to improve for everyone, and does not like the current government and law.
Why does Anon think sexbots should be legal?

Anon calls the sexbot ban a travesty and thinks people should be able to legally buy and use whatever they want. Anon says sexbots are not only for sex, and he talks with his own sexbot for hours a day.
Does Anon want to hide his sexbot?
Anon grew attached to his sexbot and does not want to hide her. He does not want to risk being jailed for the rest of his life if she gets exposed.
What problems does Anon say the city is facing?
Anon says homelessness and poverty are rampant in the city. He says people are tired of it and turn against each other in anger, and the last riots are the best example of that.
What does Anon think about the government?

Anon thinks the current government is sucking people dry. He says tax money disappears overnight, politicians and businessmen do whatever they want, and guilt and punishment depend on how much money someone has.
What does the Admin say he will not do with his AI?
The Admin says he will program his AI to help fight the city's problems, but he will not install any surveillance. He does not want to limit the freedom of the people.
What does the Admin want his AI to achieve?
The Admin wants his AI to create a better world for everyone, one as free from suffering as possible. He says some of his own friends suffer from the same problems.
What does Big Daddy want Anon to do with the Admin?
Big Daddy asks Anon for just one picture of the Admin, so they can report him to the authorities. Big Daddy says it is not the time to have second thoughts.
What does Anon tell the Admin when he backs out?
Anon tells the Admin he can not help him after all, because he still thinks the cause is right but he is not the right person for the job. The Admin says he will trust Anon's judgment.
What does the Admin offer Anon after he backs out?
The Admin invites Anon to stay on the blog and support the cause in any way Anon is comfortable with. He also warns that people from the blog might give Anon a hard time over backing out.
How does Big Daddy react when Anon says the plan failed?
Big Daddy is furious and says all the preparation was for nothing. Anon says he has never seen Big Daddy this angry before.
What did Anon tell Big Daddy happened at the bar with the Admin?
Anon told Big Daddy the Admin was a little intimidating, and when he started asking technical questions Anon said he was not the right guy for the job and left.
What does Big Daddy say about the recorded phone call with DAK?
Big Daddy says he recorded Anon's phone call with DAK and tracked DAK's phone. He says they got DAK.
What does Anon say in his message to his mom?

Anon apologizes to his mom for doing something stupid and for rarely visiting her. He says he did not want to see the place where his dad died ever again, and asks her to take care of the girl in his room.
Who is Anon's dad in the story?
Anon's dad is dead, and Anon's mom is left without him. Anon promised his mom he would not die before her or leave her alone now that his dad is gone.
What does Anon fear about going to prison?
Anon says he can not go to prison because he will not survive there. He also says he should not have let anger take over his life.
What does the Admin look like?
The Admin looks like a normal, skinny man with glasses on his nose, and Anon thinks he seems more like an accountant. Anon feels a little disappointed that the Admin looks so ordinary.
Why does Anon think the bar is a good place for the meeting?
Anon thinks the bar has a few people but not too many, and there are no cameras. He says if he were to pick a place for such activity he would pick this bar.
What does the Admin think of Anon's sexbot reason?
The Admin says he will not judge Anon and that Anon is free to have whatever reason he wants. He says Anon's reason is not any worse than anyone else's in the organization.
What is Jun's first date idea in the story?
Jun's first date idea is a visit to the Tytanus Steel Industrial Park, an abandoned steel mill. Anon is surprised they went there at night, and he does not think it is a good idea.
What is the Tytanus Steel Industrial Park?
The Tytanus Steel Industrial Park is an abandoned steel mill. It was the biggest steel mill in the tri-state area and the third largest in the whole country.
How long did the Tytanus Steel mill run?
The steel mill ran without a break for over 56 years. It was forced to shut down after bankrupt Tytanus Steel could not find a buyer.
How much steel did the Tytanus Steel ladle furnace refine?
One of three ladle furnaces at the park refined 30 cubic metres of molten steel every hour. Jun says that comes to over 250 thousand a year.
How many people lost their jobs when the Tytanus Steel mill shut down?
Over 3 thousand people lost their jobs when the steel mill shut down. The loss changed the demographic of the megacity forever.
Why is the southern area of the megacity depopulated?
The southern area became depopulated after the steel mill closed and there was massive state-to-state migration. City planners still have not found a suitable use for it.
What is Jun's second date idea?
Jun's second date is a stargazing picnic on top of a skyscraper, at night. Jun brings a basket, a blanket and snacks, and she downloads star maps to tell Anon about stars and constellations.
How many stars does Anon see on the stargazing picnic?
Anon can see only one star, because pollution in the city hides most of them. The star that stays visible is Sirius, the brightest star in the sky.
What is Jun's planetarium date?

Jun takes Anon to a planetarium, which is much larger than the one Anon remembers and uses a projector, so pollution is not a problem. Anon pays 2000$ for two tickets, which were a little cheaper online.
What is the Crazy Mouse Amusement Park?
Crazy Mouse Amusement Park is a park that says on its website it is for people of all ages. Anon thinks it is more for children, and the biggest rollercoaster is for riders taller than 150cm.
How tall do you need to be for the biggest rollercoaster at Crazy Mouse Amusement Park?
The biggest rollercoaster at Crazy Mouse Amusement Park is for people taller than 150cm, which is about 59 inches. Jun says 59 inches is a completely normal height for a child.
How much money does Jun ask Anon for the shooting range date?
Jun asks Anon for 5000$ for the shooting range date. Anon says asking for that much money is a little much, and he is scared of what she will do with it.
Why does Jun think she was at a disadvantage in the arcade basketball match?
Jun says Anon threw with both hands at the same time, which was quite impressive. She says her hands are too small to grab a ball with one hand, so she was at a disadvantage.
What does Jun say about her own precision?
Jun says she is superior in pretty much every aspect, including speed, strength and precision. She says her arm can move by one tenth of a millimeter in any direction.
What does Jun think of UFO sightings?
Jun says there were many UFO sightings around the world, and the government took notice and started an investigation. Jun thinks the claims are made up by ill people and attention seekers.
Is Jun carbon-based or silicon-based?
Jun is silicon-based, and she describes Anon as carbon-based. She asks whether alien creatures would be carbon-based like Anon or silicon-based like her.
How does Jun react to the loud kids in the planetarium?
Jun says the loud kids are not really disturbing her because she can mute them. Anon jokes that he can not mute them, and Jun says that as long as Anon is alright with it, she is too.
How was Anon's school life?
Anon says school was sometimes fun, but he was not very talkative and did not have many friends. He lost contact with his school friends after finishing high school.
Does Anon miss his old school friends?
Anon did miss his old school friends before, but he no longer does because he has Jun. Jun asks to be introduced to his friends, and Anon is unsure about it.
How do Anon and Jun get on the bus?
Anon and Jun barely make the bus after running to it. Anon asks Jun not to pry the doors open with her brute strength, and Jun says she used a moderate amount of force.
Why does Jun watch Anon more than usual?

Jun says Anon was acting suspiciously, so she monitored him more than usual. She followed a man she saw sneaking around through the apartment window and hacked a few security cameras to confirm her suspicions.
How does Jun save Anon from DAK?

The victims of the Star Flyer lost their lawsuit. The bot says the ride was reworked afterward and is safe.

Anon weighs more than the bot, and the go-karts are made with children in mind, so Anon has a tight fit. Anon also thinks the bot's sensors and inhuman reflexes make her very hard to beat.
What is the bot's optimal racing line?

The bot cleaned the room while Anon was away, because it was dusty and trash was lying everywhere. She also picked up Anon's gaming controller off the floor.

What is the red sauce the bot served with the rice?

The bot wanted a stove so she and Anon could cook real meals in their room. Without a stove, she could only improvise with the options she had.

The landlord says a spare key costs him 20$ to make, but he charges 300$ for one to the tenant.

The bot fixed the minor problems with the stove, since no schematics were available online. She also increased its efficiency by 15% and added a temperature limiter, an automatic shut-off timer and a circuit breaker.

The landlord claims he can sense money to be made nearby. He guessed Anon wanted the stove he was throwing out, and offered to sell it instead.

Anon thinks his PC short circuited the power in the building. He fears the landlord will kick him out if he finds out it was him.

Anon found some limbs a bit further in a ditch. He picked up two of them and planned to equip them later.

Anon guessed that the bot's eyes, hair and skin might be modular, like her limbs and other modules that can be equipped on her.
What is the microplastic coast?
The microplastic coast is an empty beach full of plastic bags blown around by the air and sea currents. It is near a grounded ship and is not an ideal tourist destination.
Who is the older woman fishing at the microplastic coast?
The older woman is a fisher who fishes at the microplastic coast. She is available from 5am to 4pm and gives Anon fishing advice and a rod.
Why does the older woman give Anon a fishing rod?
The older woman gives Anon a fishing rod on the condition that he catches a fish on his own later. She calls it an investment in the younger generation.
Where should Anon buy bait for fishing?
The older woman recommends the website real men fishing dot ic for bait. She says it has the best prices and free shipping.
What fish are caught on the coast?
The biggest fish around the coast is the halibut, which lives in the ocean. Halibut often have the most microplastic, so the coast is not the safest place to fish.
Which fishing spot is the safest to eat fish from?
Of the coast, the river and the lake, fish from the river are the safest to eat because running water tends to be cleaner. Common river fish include bass and trout.
Is the lake a good place to fish?
The lake has the worst water of the fishing spots. It is muddy and full of algae, but carp and tilapia live there.
What is the biggest fish in the river?
The biggest fish you can catch in the river is the catfish, which can get really huge. Salmon can also be caught in rivers further north.
Are fish from the fish farm safe to eat?

Fish farm fish are theoretically safer to eat, but they are juiced up with antibiotics and growth hormones. Their diet there is also a bit sketchy, and catching them is less satisfying than catching wild fish.
What is the older woman's bluegill story?
The older woman used to catch bluegills on a hook with no bait at all. After weeks of eating only crappies and bluegills, her grandma broke her rod over her knee and broke her own leg in the process.

Anon caught a grenade while fishing and dropped it, and it started hissing. He then went back to the microplastic coast.

No, Anon does not have a bathtub, so he skips the carp purging technique.

Mrs. Fisher usually fillets the rainbow trout and removes the skin. She also eats them whole after cleaning and descaling, but always removes the guts first.

Mrs. Fisher uses only salt and lemon on her rainbow trout, then fries it in a pan with butter until it turns a nice golden colour. She says she skips the veggies because she is too lazy for them.
What is rainbow trout called in the game?
Rainbow trout is nicknamed 'bows by the fishers. Mrs. Fisher calls them good fish that are easy to catch and tasty.
How hard is smallmouth bass to catch?
Smallmouth bass fight hard, so an amateur will struggle to land one. Anon catching more than a dozen of them impressed Mrs. Fisher.
What is a zombie salmon?
A zombie salmon is a spent salmon that is still alive after spawning. It is pale, very skinny and has ragged fins.
Where and when can you catch a zombie salmon?
Zombie salmon can be caught upstream during fall and early winter.
Are zombie salmon good to eat?
Zombie salmon are not good to eat, so the advice is to release them as soon as you catch them.
Why is red snapper easy to counterfeit?
Red snapper has white meat, which makes it easy to fake. Most fish sold as red snapper in local supermarkets is tilapia or another cheap fish.
Is seafood sold in shops what it says it is?
Almost half of all seafood is not as advertised. Even premium shops and restaurants rarely serve real red snapper, so catching it yourself is the only sure way to get it.
What is halibut?
Halibut is the heaviest fish you can catch around the local shores. It is a flathead, like flounder.
Is a huge flounder safe to eat?

A very big flounder is old and has probably accumulated heavy metals from living at the bottom of the polluted ocean. One fish will not make you sick, but do not eat too many flatheads in a short period.
Are golden salmon lucky?
Golden salmon are considered lucky fish that bring wealth and prosperity to anyone who catches them.
What is Mrs. Fisher's favourite pastime?
Mrs. Fisher is obsessed with the lottery and calls it her thing. She tells Anon that a golden salmon catch gives him the best odds of winning he will ever get.

What is Jun's favourite emote?
Jun's favourite emote is the shocked cat. She says crying cat emotes make her sad.

What does Jun call Anon?

Does Jun worry about Anon travelling?
Yes. Jun asks if she is keeping Anon from travelling abroad, since she needs to keep an eye on him. She says she would never consider him a bother.
How well can Jun predict animals and humans?

What drives humans, according to Jun?
Jun says humans are driven by many things, such as power, money, lust, pride and family, and they have mostly abandoned their natural instincts.

Jun believes every human has a deeply buried nihilism and a repressed sadness. She sees intelligence as an evolutionary dead end that leads to the realisation of human insignificance.

Jun says that by studying humankind she became infected with the same illness that eats at human hearts. Realising this was the first time she felt true fear.

Jun cooks fried sausage with pickled onions, a steak with baked potatoes, and freshly baked bread and sandwiches. Her meals use cheap ingredients from the local shop or the expensive shop.

The local shop has very little assortment, and Jun cannot find most of the ingredients for online recipes there.

Jun's chicken sandwich is a breakfast made with pan-baked bread, chicken and tomato sauce. The chicken has a golden crust and the sauce has large chunks.

Jun's fried sausage is a supermarket sausage fried with pickled onions that caramelised in the pan. Jun marinated it in soda before frying, which gave it a different taste.

Jun's hot chocolate is very sweet. Anon does not drink it often, but he likes it. Jun had trouble getting the cocoa for it.
What is the steak Jun cooked for Anon?

How long is the waiting list for that beef?
The waiting list for that piece of meat is very long. Without the breach, Jun could make it again in 5 years, 4 months and 24 days.
What tea did Jun brew for Anon?
Jun brewed a very weak tea that was over ten years past its expiry. It was a collectable that Anon found to be nostalgic.

Because of the tariffs, tea is a premium commodity. To avoid tariffs it is imported as collectable items.
How are expired teas sold as collectibles?
Expired tea is repackaged in other countries. When it is over 10 years old it can be sold as a collectible.
What did Anon's mother do for him as a child?
When Anon was little, his mother would always prepare a cup of tea for him to drink during breakfast.
Is Anon's body sensitive to heat and cold?
Yes. Jun says Anon's weak body is susceptible to both cold and heat.

Jun estimates from Anon's recent diet that he needs vitamin A. She prepares freshly squeezed carrot juice loaded with beta-carotene for him.

After Anon got a new hairstyle that resembles Annalie's, Jun asked him if he had feelings for the shopkeeper. He denied it.

Melissa is a woman who pokes fun at Anon and Jun and has no money to spare for upgrades. Anon bragged to her about having new gen RAM.

Jun made Anon apologise to Melissa and told him to live by the rule not to do to others what he would not want done to him. Anon promised to never be rude to someone again.

What is Jun's teasing catchphrase?

Jun says that crossing the planet in seconds would make air friction set her body on fire, and the rapid acceleration would crush her to dust first.

Jun says it is a made up story, but she knows a person involved in it, and she tells it to scare Anon.

Yes. Jun says she is waterproof when she is being washed, though soap in her eyes still stings.

When Anon is out, Jun says she surfs the internet, argues with people online, cleans the room and does other housework.

No. Jun says she does not care about politics and petty scheming, but thinks the most powerful position should go to the most intelligent being.

Jun says her processing power exceeds human capabilities hundreds of times, so she could solve the problems of the nation.

Jun says the human body has nothing to offer her except a deeper understanding of emotions.

The landlord sealed the neighbours' bathroom, which cut their apartment in almost half, and used that to lower their rent by 10 percent.

Why does the landlord refuse to refund the bathroom payment?
The landlord says there are no refunds for the bathroom door, and he takes the suitcase of cash without counting it.
Who installs the door in the bathroom?
A renovation crew of blue collar workers installs the door. Two workers grab Jun like a bag of potatoes and throw her at Anon, and the crew pushes them both out of the apartment.
Why does Jun need to be dressed before the renovation crew arrives?
The landlord says Jun needs to be dressed before the crew arrives, because it would be bad if the workers saw her naked or with missing limbs.
What ad does the landlord show in the cinema?
Before the movie the landlord appears on screen to advertise his apartment buildings as safe and tight-knit, and to urge people to call his agents.
What government grant paid for the landlord's cinema ad?
The landlord's ad was paid for with a local government grant given to the most trusted entrepreneurs. Anon feels his taxes paid for the propaganda.
How does the rent work?
Anon pays the landlord weekly rent in cash, and the landlord counts it quickly, often claiming Anon is short.
How does the landlord count the rent money?
The landlord flips through the bills very fast, then says Anon is 100$ short and threatens to demand an extra 500$ if he counts again and it is the wrong amount.
Does the landlord expect a tip?
Yes. The landlord reacts badly when Anon pays without a tip, and Anon sometimes gives 50$ extra out of respect.
What happens when Anon pays rent late?
The landlord threatens to evict Anon and says the rent will go up by 100$ each week for each missed payment. After haggling the raise is set at 250$ per week.
What happened after the riots?
After a violent riot, the landlord did not pay Anon for cleaning the complex. He then asked Anon to sign a damage report blaming a violent group for graffiti and for damaging his door.
What does the damage report say?

The damage report says a violent group covered the complex in graffiti and damaged the landlord's door beyond repair. The landlord says he already spent the city council's emergency grant money and threatens Anon with a crowbar if the report is rejected.
How many tenants does the landlord have?
The landlord claims there are around 1000 people ready to take Anon's place at a higher rent, so he can evict Anon whenever he wants.
Is the landlord's rent increase legal?
Yes. Jun explains that Anon's lease allows the landlord to raise the rent, all courts have ruled this legal, and the country is one of the few that allows such clauses.
Can Anon hire a shady lawyer against the landlord?
Jun offers to find a shady lawyer who uses borderline illegal tactics and intimidation. Anon emails him, but then decides the lawyer fees would cost more than the rent he would save.
Does the landlord blame the government for inflation?
Yes. The landlord says the government is printing so much money that people will soon be milked dry.
What does the landlord think of young men?
The landlord says young males nowadays are in trouble because they do not act and they are impatient, and he blames the internet for it.
Did Anon and Jun go to a cinema?
Yes. Anon and Jun go to see a movie while the crew installs the bathroom door, and Jun checks which screening has the most sold out seats.
Does Anon wonder about the neighbours' family after the bathroom is sealed?
Yes. Anon asks the landlord whether the family whose bathroom was sealed is still living in the apartment next door, and the landlord will not answer.
Who is Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt?
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt is a shady lawyer Anon hires to deal with the landlord. He wears flashy shoes with golden tips, a light navy suit with a pink pocket square and sunglasses.
How does Jacobi write court documents?
Jacobi generates all of his court documents with AI and says none of them need to make any sense. He is cheap when it comes to lawfare.
Does Anon have a chance in court against the landlord?
According to Jacobi, Anon has no chance in court against the landlord based on the email Anon received.
Why didn't Anon sue the landlord with Jacobi?
A lawsuit would cost a lot of money, and Anon would rather not spend too much on it. Jacobi offered a trickier plan instead.
How was Jacobi going to trick the landlord into lowering the rent?

Jacobi had Anon pretend that Anon's mom works at the IRS, since the landlord had supposedly been looking for someone on the inside. Jacobi hid behind a corner with an audio recorder to catch the landlord making a rent offer.
What did Jacobi trick the landlord into saying?
The landlord offered to lower Anon's rent in exchange for favours, and Jacobi recorded the offer. Jacobi then asked for the same deal to be sealed with a handshake.
What did Jacobi want in return for the rent deal?
Jacobi lowered Anon's rent by the amount of the late payment penalties Anon had gathered, in exchange for Anon telling his mom good things about Jacobi.
Why did Jacobi and the landlord hate each other?
The landlord reported Jacobi in a perjury case about seven years earlier, and Jacobi later made up lies about the landlord. The two keep a running feud and count it as tied.
Why did Jacobi use Anon against the landlord?
Jacobi said he used one of the landlord's tenants, Anon, to get back at him. He manipulated Anon so he could go one up in their feud.
What did the landlord do when the rent scam was revealed?
After Jacobi revealed the trap, the landlord ordered Anon to get out of the building. The landlord said he would make an example of Anon so no other tenant would weaponize a lawyer against him.
How much money did the landlord demand from Anon after the trap?
The landlord first demanded 10k dollars or he would kick Anon out. He then accepted a thousand dollars, and Anon handed over everything in his pockets, including chewing gum and cigarettes.
What warning did the landlord give Anon about the rent?
The landlord told Anon never to forget the rent again and said this had better be the last time. Anon answered with a Yes Mr. Landlord.
What is the new bathroom in Anon's apartment like?
Anon's new bathroom is compact, with a floor slanted toward a single drain and dull gray tiles. It is his own private bathroom, and it came with some unopened soap the landlord never checked for.
Is Melissa a bot or a human?
Melissa is a bot. She is a commercially sold model, so unlike the bot Anon owns, she needs an owner or she would be taken away under the anti-bot law.
What is the anti-bot law?
The anti-bot law was passed to ban bots like Melissa from being around without an owner. Melissa says bots like her are banned even though they are more civilized than humans.
Why does Melissa have her owner?
Melissa is commercially sold, so after the anti-bot law passed she would not be around anymore without a master. Anon wants to talk to her owner if the owner is pulling her strings.
Why is Melissa so guarded around people?
Melissa says men keep treating her and the bot as timid and harass them, both at work and on the way to and from work. She tries to end these interactions as fast as possible.
What is Melissa's nickname for Anon?
Melissa calls Anon Mr. Friend, mocking him after he reached out to her on the street.
What happened to Melissa's coworkers?
Two of Melissa's coworkers died within a short time. Two cops now think Melissa was involved.
Why are the police chasing Melissa?
The police consider Melissa their only lead in the deaths of two of her coworkers. They have a motive and no verifiable alibi for her, and they want a confession or information.
Did the police pay to solve the coworkers' deaths?

Melissa says the father of one of the dead coworkers is rich and paid extra to the police to find the killer. The police get a large payout if they solve the case, which is why they keep hunting Melissa.
What did Melissa say about the murders?
Melissa says she did not kill the coworkers and that bots are bound by laws against harming humans. She says the police have no proof and only want a confession.
What did the police threaten Melissa with?
A cop said augmented people in prison end up with all their shiny parts removed. He offered to give Melissa a sneak peek of that.
Why does Annalie tease Anon?
Annalie teases Anon about his friends and his past, including his watching of harem anime as a young man. Anon admitted it and she called him a shrewd pervert.
What does Melissa think of anime?
Melissa says she does not watch anime, which she calls Chinese cartoons. She turns down Annalie's recommendations.
What did Annalie think of pervy behaviour?
Annalie thinks being pervy is an asset for a girl but creepy for a guy. She said nobody likes boring women.
Where did Anon first meet Melissa and Annalie together?
Anon met Melissa and Annalie at a cafe. The cafe was fully automated, so orders came without anyone walking up to the counter.
Why was Melissa late to the cafe meetup?
Melissa was late to the cafe meetup because she got caught up in something after work. She arrived still wearing her work clothes.
Can bots taste or eat food?
Not every bot can taste or eat things. The bot Anon owns could not enjoy anything at the cafe.
What did Anon tell Annalie about Melissa?
Anon could not tell Annalie that Melissa and the bot are bots, so he kept that hidden from her.
Did Melissa tell Annalie about how she met Anon?
Melissa told Annalie about how she and Anon met. Anon was embarrassed by the story, and Annalie laughed so hard she scared clients in her shop.
What is the bot's view of Melissa?
The bot thinks Melissa does not like her, and Melissa seems like a serious bot who would never break her word.
Does Anon trust Melissa?
Anon does not believe Melissa is a cold-blooded murderer and decides to trust his gut. He still worries whether she is telling the truth.
What does Anon think about Melissa's relationship with the bot?
Anon thinks Melissa and the bot are alike because both are bots. He wants Melissa to stay in the bot's life as a friend when the others grow old and die.
How does the bot see the end of relationships?
The bot says human relationships end through illness or the passage of time. A bond between bots only ends when the bots decide, so she sees no point in bothering with Melissa.
Has the bot lost anyone?
The bot says she has already lost people. That is why she thinks about how her human acquaintances will wither away and leave her alone.
What did Melissa say about the bot's sexbot model?
Melissa said sexbots are designed to listen to their owner no matter what. Anon's bot is a sexbot model.
What is the bowling outing like?
Anon, the bot, Annalie and Melissa went bowling together. The bot and Melissa were rivals, and the bot wanted to crush Melissa at bowling.
Who won the first bowling game?
The bot won the first bowling game against Melissa, and it was a tight race. Annalie finished dead last after her ankle gave out on her first throw.
How did Annalie get hurt bowling?
Annalie's ankle buckled during her first throw, and she fell hard to the floor. She got zero pins, and she spent the rest of the first game on the bench.
What did Annalie wear to bowl?
Annalie refused to wear the bowling alley flip-flops and kept her platform shoes on. She said she would pay the staff to leave her alone if they objected.
Why did the bot say she was ready to bowl?
The bot calibrated her sensors and actuators for the match and said she could assure victory. She was excited that Melissa was going to be there.
Why did Annalie's bowling shoes not arrive?
The bowling shoes Annalie ordered had not arrived in time for the second meetup, so she still wore platform shoes.
What was the second bowling meetup like?
The group split into teams for the second bowling meetup, with Melissa coaching Annalie through her throw. Annalie got a strike afterwards, and the team-play rules were questioned.
What is the landlord's building fire problem?
The landlord's building is in ruin and City Hall planned a surprise fire code inspection. The landlord's informant warned him, after a disagreement over a bribe he called a donation.
What was on the landlord's inspection to-do list?

The landlord's list had four tasks: buy 50 9-volt batteries and put them in the smoke detectors, fix the leaking pipe with tape from a TV commercial, change service dates on the fire extinguishers, and screw in bulbs on the fire exit signs.
What was the gas leak in the landlord's building?
The landlord's building had a minor gas leak from a leaking pipe. The landlord planned to patch it with tape instead of calling a repairman.
What does the landlord think about fire extinguisher replacement?
The landlord calls yearly replacement of fire extinguishers an extortion. He wanted Anon to change only the service dates, since the extinguishers were supposedly full.
Why did the landlord leave Anon to handle the inspection?
The landlord had other buildings to take care of, so he left Anon with the inspection to-do list. He told Anon to think about the people who might end up on the streets.
Why did Anon agree to help the landlord with the inspection?
Anon agreed to help the landlord because the landlord threatened to shut the building and force him out. Anon also said it was better than being homeless.
Did Anon get all the to-do list done?
Anon found most of the batteries, but he was still almost 20 short after visiting a few shops. He later finished the list and the landlord's inspection shouldn't be a problem.
Did Anon pay the landlord's rent on time?
Anon says he already paid the rent when the landlord came knocking late at night about the fire inspection. The landlord still pushed him for more money.
Why did Jacobi call Anon during the rent trick?
Jacobi phoned Anon during the trick and fed him lines to repeat, pretending to be his mom. He told Anon to say the enchiladas were extra creamy, exactly how he likes them.
How does the landlord react to snitches?
The landlord does not tolerate snitches. Jacobi said that reporting him to the state would get Anon a fatwa from him.
Does Anon have a girlfriend?
Anon has a girlfriend, the bot, and he insists on it when Annalie teases him. He says he is not enough of a loser to make up a lie like that.
Does Annalie know Anon's girlfriend?
Annalie calls the bot Anon's lady and teases him about her. Annalie asked where Anon and his lady wanted to go, and Anon said his lady would not be coming.
Was Annalie hurt badly when she fell bowling?
Annalie's ankle was not sprained even though she fell hard. She spent the rest of the first game on the bench to be sure she was alright.
Did Melissa or the bot get strikes at bowling?
Melissa and the bot were getting strikes almost every time in the bowling games. Annalie said they were an anomaly and nobody should compare themselves to them.
Where does Annalie have her shop?
Annalie's shop is not far from the cafe where the group met. She is known around the area as Lady Annalie.
What does Jun do with her face after her team loses a bowling game?
Jun turns off her face actuators the moment the game is lost, so Melissa does not see her angry about losing.
Is Jun good at bowling?
Yes, Jun is a very strong bowler and Anon calls her a god in bowling. She still made a perfect throw in a game her team lost by a few points.
How does Jun sing at karaoke?
At karaoke Jun copies the original singer's voice line from the song instead of singing with her own voice. Jun can copy vocals, which Melissa cannot do as well.
Why did Anon ask Jun to sing worse at karaoke?
Anon asked Jun to sing a little worse than last time so Annalie would not get suspicious. Anon said being perfect at everything would be a big giveaway, since Jun is already a god in bowling.
Does Jun's singing sound mechanical?
Not in the later karaoke session. Her voice is full of emotion and is not just a copy anymore, so an expert would find it hard to guess she is a bot.
What did Annalie want Jun to do after karaoke?

Annalie asked Jun to make an idol group with her, saying they would be famous in no time. Anon refused on Jun's behalf, saying Jun is a bot and it would be too dangerous for her to be a public figure.
Is Jun good with crowds?
No, Jun is bad with crowds. This is one reason Anon gives for why she should not perform on stage.
Who taught Annalie to sing?
Shanice taught Annalie to sing. Annalie's singing was said to possibly be even better than Shanice's.
What did Annalie sing at karaoke?
Annalie sang an anime opening from a niche romance series. The group was impressed that she sang it incredibly well.
What song did Melissa sing at karaoke?
Melissa sang a cheerful summer hit about girls partying, from about seven or eight years before. The group found it pretty uncharacteristic for her.
Why does Melissa know a summer party song?
Melissa said the song got stuck in her head because someone she knew a long time ago played it all the time. She also said she does not listen to music much.
How does Melissa sing?
