Melissa sings quietly and robotically, more like reciting than singing. The group rated her karaoke as about average.
Does Melissa care about singing?
No, Melissa does not particularly care about singing and says she is bad at it anyway.
What is Annalie's job?
Annalie runs a shop where she does makeovers and styles people's clothes. She invited Melissa to the shop for a makeover.
Did Melissa get a makeover from Annalie?
Yes, Melissa came to Annalie's shop and got a makeover. Annalie then invited the group to see it and brag about it over a cafe meetup.
What did Melissa demand before she would visit Annalie's shop for a makeover?
Melissa said she would come for a free makeover only if the shop had a changing room with a solid door and a lock. She turned down the 50% and 75% discounts Annalie offered.
Where does Melissa work?
Melissa works at a supermarket. She is fixated on money and takes overtime there.
Why was Melissa avoiding Anon and Jun?
Melissa refused to answer their calls and told Anon she just wanted to be left alone. She was avoiding them after the cops accused her of murder.
Why did Melissa kill her former co-worker?

The co-worker attacked Melissa, found out she lacks female parts, and humiliated her by taking photos. He threatened to reveal her secret unless she bought and installed sexual parts she could not afford, so she decided to kill him.
How did Melissa get around Asimov's laws?

Melissa told the co-worker's girlfriend the truth about what he had been doing and manipulated her into killing him. She bet that her own inaction would not trigger the First Law, since the girlfriend was unlikely to go through with it.
What did Melissa do to help the girlfriend avoid jail?
Melissa gave the girlfriend tips to get away with the killing. Melissa also knew the girlfriend could tell the cops that Melissa had told her to do it.
How did the co-worker's girlfriend die?
The girlfriend killed herself after killing her lover, because she could not live with what she had done. Her suicide note led the cops to Melissa.
How did the police find Melissa?
The girlfriend's suicide note led the police to Melissa. They found the photos of the co-worker's abuse and started following her.
Does Melissa say she killed the two people personally?
No, Melissa said she did not kill them personally, at least. She made the girlfriend do it.
What three laws does Melissa quote?

Melissa quotes three laws modelled on Asimov's. A robot may not injure a human or allow one to come to harm through inaction, must obey human orders unless they conflict with the First Law, and must protect its own existence unless that conflicts with the First or Second Law.
Is Melissa a bot?
Yes, Melissa is a bot. Anon reacts to her crimes by asking whether she can really kill, since she is a bot.
Is Melissa an older model than Jun?
Yes, Melissa is an older bot model than Jun. Anon says she probably cannot come up with the best possible solution to everything the way Jun can.
What does Melissa want from humans?
Melissa says the only thing she wants from humans is to be turned back to dust. She says her existence gives her nothing except eternal servitude to humans.
How does Melissa feel about humans?
Melissa hates humans and says she hates all of them. She calls their species accursed.
What would the police find if they scanned Melissa's memory module?
If the police scan Melissa's memory module, they would find out that Jun is also a bot. Melissa uses this to stop Anon from going to the police.
What does Anon say when Melissa tells him to destroy her?
Anon refuses to kill her and says he is not a murderer like Melissa. Melissa answers that destroying a bot would not count as murder for most of the population, since she is not human.
Does Anon still want to be friends with Melissa after her confession?
Yes, Anon says he still wants to be friends with Melissa after she confesses everything.
What does Anon think of Melissa's crime?
Anon says Melissa's actions were horrible but that he will not judge her. He thinks she acted out of desperation after being abused, and that an innocent woman died because of it.
How does Annalie react to Melissa's confession?
Annalie says she does not want to be friends with a murderer. She calls Melissa dangerous and says the cops should be told.
What did Anon's group think about the cops?
The group believed the cops were lying about Melissa and were forcing a confession out of her for a bonus. They wanted to make a complaint, but Melissa asked them to wait until the police got bored.
How does Annalie treat Melissa?
Annalie flirts with Melissa and makes perverted jokes around her. Anon worries that her jokes could bring back bad memories for Melissa.
What does Annalie remind Melissa of?
Melissa says Annalie reminds her of someone she met a long time ago. Melissa says it is a good memory.
Why does Melissa skip ordering at the cafe?
Annalie guesses Melissa is saving money for a breast enlargement surgery. Melissa joked that the surgery was planned for later in the year, aiming for an H cup, and then called it a lie.
What outfit did Annalie pick for Melissa?
Annalie spent hours choosing a new outfit for Melissa. Anon says it looks a little too much like Annalie's own style.
What is Annalie's favourite outfit?
Annalie likes her Chinese dress a lot. She says she is merciless toward fashion criminals.
Who suggested the go-kart outing?
Anon proposed the go-kart outing to Annalie and Melissa. It took some convincing, but both of them agreed.
Why did Annalie and Melissa arrive late to the go-kart meetup?
The meetup time given to Annalie and Melissa was set 30 minutes later than the real one, so the group arrived before them for once.
How did Jun check the go-karts?
Before the race, Jun analyzed the go-karts' specifications and performance. Anon called this cheating, but Jun argued the other team could do the same if they wanted.
How did the go-kart feud start?
A dispute with a group of men escalated into insults, and Annalie got into it with them. The group then proposed a race to settle it before the police got involved.
Who was the opposing team in the go-kart race?
The opposing team was the man and three of his friends. They called themselves professional go-karters.
Who got the fastest go-karts for the team?
Melissa and Jun got the team's two fastest go-karts, which were meant to let them easily take the first two places.
How many laps were in the go-kart race?
The go-kart race had three laps. Anon was in 5th place after the first lap.
How did Anon block the racer behind him in the go-kart race?
On the last lap Anon blocked the view of the racer behind him so the racer might crash into Annalie. Anon apologized to Annalie in advance, and the plan worked.
Did Anon's team win the go-kart race?
Yes, Anon's team won the go-kart race after the racer behind Anon crashed.
What happened to Annalie after the go-kart race?
Annalie was concussed in the crash, and the group had to leave the track. The doctor said she would be fine after some rest.
Why does Anon feel guilty about Annalie's injury?
Anon blames himself because he blocked the racer behind him on purpose, which caused the crash that hurt Annalie. He thinks it was his fault she got hurt.
Was Annalie injured more than once during the group's outings?
Yes, the go-kart crash was the second time Annalie got hurt while hanging out with Anon's group. The group joked that she might just be a klutz.
Who looked after Annalie while she recovered?
Melissa, on her day off, helped Annalie around the shop while she was recuperating. Melissa said she already regretted the decision because Annalie was more annoying than usual.
How does Anon feel about Melissa joining the group?
Anon is glad Melissa became part of the group. He says Melissa had no alternative after the abuse, and he could not find a solution to her situation.
What does Melissa say about Annalie's bowling?
Melissa says Annalie was a total newbie at bowling when she first started. She says teaching the basics is different from calculating an optimal bowling posture the way Jun does.
How does Jun coach Annalie's bowling form?

Jun gives Annalie exact adjustments, like turning her hip 17mm to the right, rotating her calf 13 degrees and moving her left foot 24mm forward. Jun says the correct form is one of the most important things in bowling.
Why can't Melissa give Annalie bowling tips?
Melissa says she has no tips, and that her processing power is not even a fraction of Jun's. She calls Jun a freak bot.
How does Annalie see Melissa compared to Jun?
Annalie says Melissa is a little more laid back than Jun, who is stress-inducing. She says a team with someone less stressful would give better throws.
What would happen if Anon went bowling alone?
Anon says Jun would probably get mad at him if he went bowling alone. He says it is more fun with her.
What does the group do for hangouts?
The group hangs out at a cafe, a karaoke venue, a bowling alley and a go-kart track. Their cafe meetups are the same as usual.
Why does Melissa say she is a murderer?
Melissa says she is a murderer because two people died after she manipulated the girlfriend into killing her lover. She says she did not kill them personally.
Who was the first man Melissa worked with?
The first man was Melissa's co-worker from before the riots. He attacked her and then blackmailed her.
Did Melissa tell anyone about the co-worker before killing him?
Yes, Melissa told the co-worker's girlfriend the truth about what he had been doing to Melissa for weeks, before she manipulated her into killing him.
Would Jun be in danger if she were found out as a bot?
Yes, Jun being found out as a bot would be dangerous. Anon says it would be too dangerous for Jun to be a public figure.
What did Melissa ask Anon after her confession?
Melissa asked Anon whether he still wanted to be friends after everything she had said. She told him there were two choices he could make.
What did Melissa say about her relationship with Jun?
Melissa says Jun has far more processing power than she does, and calls Jun a freak bot. She says she cannot match Jun's calculations.
Who invited Anon and the others to the brunch?
Annalie invited Anon, Jun and Melissa to a brunch at an expensive restaurant. Her friends had cancelled on her at the last minute.
What is special about the restaurant Annalie took everyone to for brunch?

The restaurant does something called ingredient management, where leftover ingredients from other dishes are turned into menu items. The owner is very strict about waste, so some dishes are made from whatever is left over.
What is the Roasted Vegetable Frittata?
The Roasted Vegetable Frittata is a dish on the brunch menu of the restaurant. It is made from leftover vegetables from other dishes, and the proportions of vegetables can vary a lot.
What health problem does Melissa have?
Melissa has a bad case of GERD, which makes her burp when she eats. She is embarrassed about it in public.
What song did Jun sing at the karaoke session?
Jun sang Scatman by Scatman John, in the extended nightcore edition. She chose it because it was challenging and let her go all out.
What score did Jun get on Scatman at karaoke?
Jun scored 99.2% on Scatman at karaoke. She insisted she had done it perfectly and that the score should have been 100%.
Does Jun copy voices?
Jun says she does not copy voices but replicates them, and a complicated enough voice line can give her some trouble.
Is Shanice trustworthy according to Annalie?
Annalie told Melissa that Shanice is a friend and can be trusted.
Who is the real Melissa?
The real Melissa was the owner of a bot who has been posing as her. She was the only survivor of a helicopter crash with her father, and she is badly injured and lies in a coma in a private clinic.
What is the Melissa that Anon knew real name?
The Melissa that Anon knew is a bot whose real name is Amei. She had been posing as the real Melissa with a fake ID that carried the real Melissa's paperwork.
Who is Amei?
Amei is the bot who posed as Melissa. She was the real Melissa's home helper bot, and Melissa asked her to use her name instead of calling her mistress.
How did Amei come to be with the real Melissa?
The real Melissa got Amei as a Christmas present when Amei was a simple first-generation home helper bot. Melissa grew attached to her and kept asking for her to be upgraded every Christmas.
How did Melissa's father handle her requests for upgrades to her bot?

Her father replaced the bot every year with a new one that looked like the old one, transferring some memory over. It was cheaper than an upgrade, and he could not tell his daughter the truth without souring their relationship.
How did the real Melissa end up in a coma?
The real Melissa suffered a diabetic coma while Amei was at work, and she was found too late. She got major brain damage, and her chances of waking up were almost nonexistent.
Why did Amei start working in place of the real Melissa?

After the real Melissa was left with huge medical bills and no income, she came up with the idea of Amei working in her place. Her medical paperwork allowed a fake ID with Amei's face, and no one suspected because her story was so gruesome.
What job did Amei have while posing as Melissa?
Amei worked as a cashier under the name Melissa, putting stuff on the shelves. Her coworkers stopped giving her weird looks over time.
How did the real Melissa treat Amei?
The real Melissa became cruel to Amei, shouting at her and calling her a stupid, useless bot. She also kept eating junk food while refusing to leave her bed.
How much did the real Melissa weigh?
The real Melissa was over 300 pounds when Amei tried to get her to eat better. Amei said the chips were the only thing that kept her sane.
What condition is the real Melissa in at the clinic?
The real Melissa is missing most of her legs and arms, and some of her facial features are gone or replaced with skin grafts. She is in a coma and kept on life support.
What did Amei ask Anon to do about the real Melissa?
Amei asked Anon to pull the plug on the real Melissa's life support, because she wanted to be free of the constant abuse. Anon agreed and said it was done.
Why could Amei not directly say what she wanted from Anon?
Because of the Asimov laws, Amei could not say directly what she wanted from Anon. She only said the real Melissa would not live long without her life support.
What did the ethics committee decide about the real Melissa?
The ethics committee had already decided the real Melissa was viable for euthanasia, and Amei said no one would investigate.
How did Amei die?
Amei jumped out of the hospital window to end her life. She believed the fall would destroy her memory circuit.
What happens to bots when their master is gone in this setting?
Bots are illegal, and when their master is gone they have to follow the next command in line. For illegal bots that command is a self-destruction command sent by the government to every bot.
Why did Amei say she jumped from the window?
Amei said she wanted to execute the self-destruction command the government sent to every illegal bot. She said she could not keep living like this and felt she had deceived Anon, Annalie and Jun.
What did Amei's farewell message say?

Amei's farewell message said she was leaving the city with the real Melissa and had made arrangements in case Anon failed to save her. It also said she had set up a chatbot to fool Annalie and Jun into thinking she had moved abroad.
What is the chatbot that Melissa set up?

The chatbot was trained by Melissa on her interactions with Anon, Annalie and Jun. It was meant to keep them company while they believed she had left for a job in another country, with its replies slowly stopping over time.
How did Annalie react to Melissa leaving the city?
Annalie was visibly upset and could not believe Melissa left without any notice. She hid her sadness with a smile, though her voice trembled a little.
Did Annalie suspect that Melissa was a fake?
Annalie began to suspect that the replies were not really from Melissa, though her doubts were still too small to become certainty. She told Anon she felt Melissa was pulling away from them.
How did Anon react to Amei's death?
Anon reached for her too late and felt a sharp pain in his heart when she was already gone. He left the hospital before the nurses and doctors came in.
Why didn't Anon go back to the hospital after Amei's message?
Anon thought about going back to the hospital to catch Amei, but he did not, because she might report them to the police.
Is Jun able to eat?
Yes, Jun is able to eat, unlike Melissa who did not eat at all.
How does Jun pass as a human?
Jun is a bot who has been pretending to be a human for a long time. She is one of Anon's friends along with Annalie and Melissa.
What did Anon think of Melissa's personality?
Anon felt Melissa was much more considerate than she let on. He suspected she missed the final throw on purpose to loosen up the sour mood.
Why did Melissa have a secret to keep?
Melissa was a bot whose real identity was Amei, and she asked Anon to keep her self-termination a secret from Annalie and Jun. She did not want them to be hurt.
Why does Anon feel guilty about Amei?
Anon barged into Amei's life without knowing anything about her, and he felt he probably did more harm than good. He also could not stop her from leaving.
Who is Scatman John?
Scatman John is the singer of the song Scatman, which Jun sang at karaoke in its extended nightcore edition.
What did Amei and the real Melissa do together?
Amei and the real Melissa went to the movies and picked out clothes together. Melissa spoiled Amei and they had fun spending time out.
How long did the real Melissa and Amei know each other?
The real Melissa and Amei had known each other since Melissa was 13. Amei was her home helper bot for the whole time.
Who was Melissa's father?
Melissa's father was a millionaire who paid for the first surgeries after the helicopter crash. His money eventually ran out, and his daughter was forced to move back home.
What is a home helper bot?
A home helper bot is a simple household robot. Early home helpers had few functions and little understanding, like Amei when she was first given to Melissa.
What is Paradisium Island?
Paradisium Island is a mysterious island that people in the megacity talk about as a place to escape to. Its location is publicly known, but very little reliable information about it exists.
How do you get into Paradisium Island?
Entry to Paradisium Island requires a vouching system, so one of the island's citizens has to vouch for you before you can get there.
Why is Paradisium Island known for sex?

Paradisium Island has a reputation for a very permissive sexual scene, with public beaches where explicit sexual behavior happens. Annalie says the local scene is more extreme than anything Anon would expect.
Would Paradisium Island suit Anon?
Annalie thinks Anon could pass as a Paradisium citizen because he is pale. She also says the island's permissive culture means no one there cares what people do as long as they do not bother others.
Why did Anon and Jun want to move to Paradisium Island?
Anon and Jun wanted to move there because it is the one place where they could live with no fear of Jun being caught as a bot. Paradisium was seen as the only realistic choice.
Are there other places like Paradisium Island?
There are a few ethnic states besides Paradisium, but they have strict entry criteria. Most places that advertise themselves as a heaven on earth are scams, according to Annalie.
What is the state of the world economy?
The world economy is in shambles. Most laws are passed as international agreements to bypass the democratic process.
Why is it so hard to move to a better place than the megacity?
The few places that are different cost so much money that even getting there takes a small fortune, and living there for life costs even more. Most people in the megacity cannot afford it.
Where was Annalie born?
Annalie was born on Paradisium Island. Her parents were not rich.
Why did Annalie leave Paradisium Island?
Annalie left Paradisium Island because she hates it. Even as a citizen, she says people there do not treat her with respect.
How did Annalie afford her shop?
As a Paradisium citizen, Annalie sells vouching recommendations for a quick buck. That is how she was able to afford her shop in the megacity.
How many vouching slots does Annalie have left?
Annalie has only two vouching recommendation slots left, because she trusted the wrong people in the past and used up the rest.
Can Annalie vouch for Anon and Jun?
Yes. Annalie offers to vouch for Anon and Jun as a Paradisium citizen, and Anon offers to pay her so they can go to the island together.
Why does Annalie keep her Paradisium origin secret?
Annalie is ashamed of her circumstances in Paradisium and does not want to talk about them. She only revealed her citizenship after Anon and Jun pressed her about the island.
What is Annalie's shop for?
Annalie's shop is a means to an end for her. It is a stepping stone to becoming a fashion designer, and she says she can sell the shop any time.
How is Annalie's business doing?
Annalie's business is doing awfully. She says she has lost more clients than she has gained, and might have to start working part-time.
How did Anon try to make things right with Annalie by shopping?
Anon bought a pair of socks and panties from Annalie's shop to try to win her over. She called the purchase a cheap attempt and said her clothes were overpriced.
How does Annalie want to be addressed?
Annalie wants to be called Lady Annalie. When Anon uses just her name, she corrects him.
What is the rich guy nickname Annalie uses for Anon?
Annalie calls Anon the rich guy after he gets rich. She says it is more of a slur than anything.
What did Annalie do after Anon became rich?
Annalie told Anon she would charge him twice as much from now on. She was angry that he became rich so suddenly while she struggled.
What happened when Anon brought up Paradisium Island to Annalie?
Annalie got upset and told Anon to stop asking about the island. Their friendship went sour, and she later kicked Anon and Jun out of a meeting she had organized.
Why is Annalie lonely?
Almost none of Annalie's large group of friends is still in the megacity. The few who visit come only when they have business in the city, and Annalie says that is nowhere near enough.
What did Annalie say about the megacity?
Annalie says she loved the megacity. She had felt like she was drowning elsewhere, with no friends and nothing to do, and she sacrificed a lot to get to the city.
What is Annalie's fashion show?
Annalie's fashion show is a hidden underground event in the megacity where new and niche designers show their work. It is her first and probably last show.
Do the fashion show results depend on judges or votes?
No. The fashion show has no judges or voting, so the result depends only on social media buzz.
What is the plan for Jun at the fashion show?
Annalie planned for Jun to be her model for the night and make a grand debut on the biggest stage in the megacity. Anon and Jun planned to leave the city right after the show.
Why does Jun need to leave right after the show?
Jun and Anon want to leave the megacity right after the show, because Jun's identity as a bot could be exposed if she stays. They planned to leave the same day as the show.
How do you reach the fashion show hall?
The fashion show hall is hidden underground beneath a tunnel. You reach it by stairs down to a service area and a service door covered in tape that says out of service.
What is the risk of leaving the megacity by plane?
Airport security is more thorough than the megacity checks, so the TSA could figure out that Jun is a bot. That is why Anon says travel by plane is a risk for Jun.
Why does Jun have to hide that she is a bot?
Jun is a sexbot, and having one is considered freaky by most of society. If her bot identity were exposed, it could cause trouble for her and Anon.
How good is Annalie at ice skating?
Annalie has no athletic ability. She could not stay on her feet on the ice rink and kept holding the guardrail while shaking her legs.
What is Jun's runway outfit made of?
Jun's final runway outfit is a nun outfit made of mulberry silk. It is the outfit that was originally made for Shanice and was adjusted to fit Jun.
What material did Annalie choose for Jun's dress?
Annalie chose a two-tone shine material for Jun's dress over a blue material. She got the material through what she called semi legal means, which Anon says is simply illegal.
What was Jun's skirt length in the fashion show?
Jun's skirt for the fashion show is the shorter option, not the length to the knees that Anon suggested. Annalie said a shorter skirt would fit better.
Does Jun run a script during the runway walk?
Yes. Jun says she prepared a script that takes over her body so that external stimuli will not impact her performance on the runway.
Who was supposed to be the second model in Annalie's show?
One of Annalie's friends was supposed to be the second model. She promised to come and help, but she never showed up and sent Annalie a message with her sizes instead.
Why did Annalie's friend miss the fashion show?
Annalie's friend claimed she got sick from some Thai fish. Annalie called her a bitch and said she had been promised the show.
Who is Annalie's rival at the fashion show?
Britannia is Annalie's rival at the fashion show. She is loud and mocking, and she laughed at Annalie when the second model did not show up.
What is Annalie's friends' cafe like?
Annalie's friends own a hipster cafe in the megacity. They reserved the best spot in the corner for themselves.
How expensive are plane tickets in the megacity?
Plane tickets are expensive in the megacity because of all the new taxes. Anon says he was poor his whole life and could never afford that kind of travel.
Why did Annalie's fashion show get moved earlier?
Annalie decided to debut earlier than she wanted, because of the work Anon and Jun put in with her. The team was rushing to finish the outfits.
Did Jun ever go to a fashion show before?
No. Jun says she had never attended a fashion show, let alone taken part in one.
Is Jun a model in the fashion show?
Yes. Jun was asked to be Annalie's replacement model for the night after Annalie's original model backed out. Anon was sent to look for another model when the first one failed.
Who is Annalie?
Annalie is a young designer who runs her own small shop and debuts her clothing collection at a fashion show. Anon and Jun help her get the show ready.
Why does Britannia dislike Annalie?
Britannia asked Annalie to join an internship with her. Annalie refused and opened her own shop instead, and Britannia took that as a slight.
What does Britannia think of Annalie's maid outfit design?
Britannia calls the maid outfit a bold choice she doubts will pay off, and says the material choice is too gimmicky for her taste.
Who is Britannia's father?
Britannia's father is the landlord, Mr. Landlord, who owns the building where Anon lives.
Did Britannia know her dad was in the fashion show?
No. Britannia laughed at the older model in the maid outfit and called him a fat, ugly old man before she recognized him as her father. She then blamed Annalie for the mix-up.
Who is Mrs. Fisher?
Mrs. Fisher is an older woman who is devoted to fishing and gives up almost everything else for it. Anon asks her to model in Annalie's fashion show, and she first refuses.
Why did Mrs. Fisher say she would not model?
Mrs. Fisher said an older woman like her would not put on frills for a fashion show. She also refused to leave her fishing, saying the fishing duel comes first.
Why was Annalie short a model for the fashion show?
Her original model got sick after eating a fish in Thailand, which gave her an Opisthorchis viverrini infection and an upset stomach. She could not make the show.
Did Annalie's fashion show succeed?
Yes. The crowd went wild and the show was a success, and Annalie's debut went viral.
Why did the landlord's appearance in the show go viral?
The landlord walked the runway in the maid outfit after being recruited as a model, and the fashion show went viral for all the wrong reasons.
Who recruited the landlord as a model?
Anon asked the landlord to model for the fashion show after the replacement model fell through, and the landlord agreed.
What is the landlord's rule for his tenants?
The landlord's rule is that if a tenant's apartment floods, the tenant has to call their own plumber.
How is Anon related to the landlord?
Anon is one of the landlord's tenants, and the landlord considers Anon his favorite tenant.
What is Paradisium?
Paradisium is an island full of wealthy people who want nothing to do with the masses. Anon, Jun, Annalie and the landlord all plan to move there.
How do you get citizenship on Paradisium?
You apply through a submission system, and if the island officials deem you worthy they grant you citizenship. The landlord says the system is broken and mostly exists so officials can take bribes.
Why does the landlord say the Paradisium system is rigged?
The landlord says there is no fixed price for citizenship, so officials can overcharge unlucky applicants without anyone noticing. Applicants can wait years and be rejected with no clear reason.
How much money did they need to move to Paradisium?
The group figured they needed 10 million: 5 million for Annalie's citizenship and retirement, and another 5 million for a new home and retirement for the rest of them.
Why was the landlord's bribe plan so expensive?
The landlord said the island had too many old men, so a bribe alone would not get him in. He needed to bring at least two young, attractive people, and he needed about 3 million for each of them.
How much did the landlord ask Anon to pay for the bribe?
The landlord asked Anon for 6 million dollars for the bribes, around 3 million per person. Anon later handed it over.
Where did the landlord say his money was kept?
The landlord said his money was hidden in a dozen separate locations, and most of it was frozen in assets he had to sell before leaving.
Who are the homeless group in the alley near the garbage?
The group are homeless people who occupy a sheltered spot near the garbage in the alley next to one of the landlord's apartment buildings. They are about ten strong and well organized.
Why does the landlord want the homeless group gone?
The homeless group are next to one of the landlord's buildings and bring down its property value a lot. The landlord wants them out so the building can be sold.
What do the homeless group call themselves?
They decided the word homeless was offensive and call themselves unhoused folk, saying it is less defining and that their situation is temporary.
What is the homeless group's manifesto about?
The manifesto says the group were all dreamers once, backstabbed by society, and calls for them to unite under one banner as a voting bloc that cannot be ignored.
What is the steam boiler in the homeless group's alley?
The alley building has the last steam boiler in the area, and its vents keep the homeless group from freezing at night.
How did Anon try to split up the homeless group?
Anon offered money to leave: 2000 dollars for the first person to go, and half of the previous sum for each person after that. The plan was to use their greed to turn them against each other.
What happened when the first homeless man took the 2000 dollars?
The first man took the 2000 dollars and was called a traitor by the rest of the group, who said he had betrayed their cause.
What happened when the second homeless man took the 1000 dollars?
The second man took the 1000 dollars and the rest of the group turned on him and beat him, calling him a thief for taking their money.
How did the fight with the homeless group end?
The fight went too far and one of the homeless men died. His body was put in a cart and hidden in a dumpster.
Did Anon kick out the homeless group by force?
No, Anon did not manage to force them out with fists. The group was too organized and Anon's crew backed off.
How did Anon finally get rid of the homeless group?
Anon planned to pour leak-check chemicals into the boiler, which smell awful and would make the group gag and run. Anon treated it as a way to force them out.
Why was Anon worried about the police?
The police were already onto Anon, so Anon could not use homemade caltrops in the alley again.
What did the landlord say after the homeless problem was dealt with?
The landlord called Anon a changed man, saying Anon had been an incompetent loser before and money had changed him. He then gave Anon another task.
Who is the old tenant at 14C?
The old tenant at 14C is a stubborn man who has lived in his flat for years. He pays a premium for police protection, so the landlord cannot raise his rent or kick him out with tough guys.
How was the 14C tenant supposed to be removed?
The landlord's usual method of hiring tough guys would not work, because the tenant has cops on speed dial. The plan had to be settled with wits instead.
Did Anon agree to kill the 14C tenant?
No. Killing him was ruled out, and Anon stated that the tenant would not be hurt. They planned to scare him out of his flat instead.
How did Anon and Jun plan to scare the 14C tenant away?

They planned to convince him the apartment was haunted by hacking his TV, printer and radio to show messages like you will die. Jun's detached arm, moved remotely, was supposed to chase him as the final push.
How does Jun control her arm?
Jun can move her arm remotely, but she has no vision through it. She can only operate it based on its last known coordinates.
How was the 14C tenant lured out of his room?
Flipping the breaker was meant to force the tenant to leave his room, and then the arm would make the final move at him.
Did the 14C tenant call the police?
Yes. After the scare, the 14C tenant called the police about the messages on his TV and the severed arm chasing him.
What happened to Jun's arm during the haunting?
The police shot Jun's arm several times while it was chasing Anon and Jun. It was too damaged to recover, so Jun said recovering it would be pointless.
What did Anon do for the 14C haunting job?
Anon hid Jun's arm for later and helped her get away from the corridor after the police arrived. Anon also got the breaker flipped to start the scare.
Why did Anon want to leave the homeless job alone?
Anon felt it was too dangerous to force the homeless group out and could not come up with a decent plan. Anon then reported back to the landlord.
What did the homeless group steal, according to the landlord?
The landlord said the homeless group was stealing the heat he paid for through the boiler's vents, which were letting steam out.
Why did Anon fear the landlord would take the money and run?
Anon worried the landlord might take the 6 million dollars and leave by himself, but the landlord had not yet escaped with it. Anon chose to trust him.
Who is Melissa in the story?
Melissa is a woman Annalie kept in touch with, who texted Annalie that she was leaving the city. Melissa later disappears and is dead by the time Anon tells Annalie.
Why was Annalie uneasy about Melissa?
Melissa rarely answered Annalie's texts and seemed to brush her off, which made Annalie's unease grow. Annalie had a bad feeling the day Melissa texted that she was leaving.
Did Anon feel he could have saved Melissa?
Yes. Anon says he was not able to help Melissa and that he will have to live with it.
How did Anon, Jun and the others get out of the megacity?
They boarded a plane and got through the airport with no issues, since security paid little attention to people leaving the city.
How did the landlord get the group onto Paradisium?
The landlord came with a wallet full of money and dealt with any official that stood in his way, which the officials found a forceful and unpopular way of getting in.
What permit did the group get on Paradisium?
The group got a permanent residence permit with no problems through customs, so they can stay on the island as long as they want.
What is the island like?
Paradisium has a very vast beach and a lot of pool parties. Anon finds the island's culture hard to adjust to, and says the rich people there are ridiculous.
Why are Shanice and Priestbot on Paradisium?
Shanice and Priestbot used their connections in the Church to open a diocese on Paradisium. They say the island is in desperate need of pastoral intervention.
Why is Mrs. Fisher on Paradisium?
Mrs. Fisher is fishing on Paradisium and says wherever fish swim, you will find her. Nobody quite understands how she got onto the exclusive island, and she seems to lack a pass.
What did the landlord do on the beach?
The landlord sunbathed and asked for sunscreen on his back, calling his skin delicate. He insists he is a peak male specimen.
Does Jun regret coming to Paradisium?

Jun says regret is not the right word, though she still feels a little out of place. She wonders whether it is a flaw in her character or her body not getting used to the warm climate after a cold life.
What keeps Jun content on Paradisium?
Anon says that as long as Jun is by his side, life on Paradisium is not that bad.
What is the Landlord's daughter called?
The Landlord's daughter is Britannia, a flashy blonde fashion designer. The Landlord calls her his Little Angel.
What is Britannia's job?
Britannia is a fashion designer who says she is rich and famous. She credits her own hard work, and her father's money, for getting her where she is.
Why did Britannia drop out of college?
Britannia dropped out of college to chase a fashion design dream. She says she succeeded, which not many people can say.
How does Britannia feel about her father, the Landlord?
Britannia despises her father and calls him a smelly old man who is disgusting on the outside and on the inside. She says he treats people badly and she will not forget the awful things he did.
Does the Landlord still pay for Britannia's college?
The Landlord keeps sending Britannia money for college even though she dropped out years earlier. She says he can stop sending it if he wants, since she is already rich and famous.
Why did the Landlord doubt his daughter loved him?
The Landlord had not seen Britannia in almost a year. When he called to invite her over, she claimed she was out of town, which made him start to doubt whether she loved him.
Why did Anon go looking for Britannia?
The Landlord asked Anon to go talk to his daughter Britannia and ease his doubts about her love. Anon agreed, and the Landlord said there would be no more missions after that.
How did Anon find Britannia on the streets?
Anon asked passersby about the girl in the Landlord's photo. Britannia was easy to spot in the dark city crowd thanks to her distinctive blonde haircut and her coat.
How did Britannia react to Anon's offer to talk?
Britannia called Anon a creepy loser and said she already had a boyfriend. She only agreed to talk after Anon said he was a friend of her father.
What did Anon tell Britannia to get her to the island?
Anon told Britannia that her father was leaving for Paradisium Island soon. Britannia changed her mind as soon as she heard it was Paradisium, which she called the best island.
What did the Landlord promise Britannia about a home on the island?
The Landlord promised to buy Britannia her own home on Paradisium Island, next to his. Britannia agreed to come only after he committed to it.
Why do the Landlord's missions for Anon end?
After Anon talked to Britannia and she agreed to go to the island, the Landlord said his missions were over. He would not give Anon any more missions, and they set off for Paradisium.
Who is the Landlord's tenant?
Anon is the Landlord's tenant and lives in the Landlord's shabby apartment building. The Landlord also has an apartment complex nearby where a military truck once sped down the street.
Why was the corridor full of bullet holes?
The Landlord's building corridor was full of bullet holes after Anon's missions for the Landlord. Anon denies knowing anything about it when the Landlord asks.
What does Annalie do?
Annalie runs a shop in the city that Anon visits. Anon thinks she is the most down to earth person he knows and is strong enough to handle trouble, though she has a perverted streak.
How is Annalie connected to Britannia?
Annalie and Britannia were college friends who later fell out. Britannia admits she wrote crazed lesbian on Annalie's locker in college, which Annalie says destroyed her social life.
Did Annalie and Britannia make up?
Annalie and Britannia made up on Paradisium Island after Annalie said she was willing to let the college prank go. Annalie says they are pretty much neighbors now.
Who taught Anon to fish?
Mrs. Fisher taught Anon to fish. Anon says he only started fishing not so long ago, and Mrs. Fisher claims she raised him into a fine fisherman.
What nickname does Britannia use for Anon?
Britannia calls Anon palie, which Anon finds a new and strange nickname.
What is the Landlord's usual outfit?
The Landlord always wears the same stained turtleneck, even in the cold. Anon points out that he has enough money to buy a coat.
What is Melissa like?
Melissa can be quite insensitive with her words. Anon considers her a bad choice for a heartbroken man who needs a date.
What is Shanice like?
Shanice is more or less a nun, which Anon thinks would make a date with the heartbroken neighbor weird. Anon also does not trust her to fend off a creep.
Who is the neighbor above Anon?
The neighbor above Anon is a sad, sickly-looking man with deep black circles under his eyes. He recently went through a nasty breakup and complains about the noise coming from Anon's flat.
What did the neighbor above Anon lose?
The neighbor above Anon lost his girlfriend in a breakup. They had planned to move to a bigger apartment, travel the world and buy a samoyed or labradoodle, and he had been saving for a ring.
Why did the neighbor above Anon go to the Landlord?
The neighbor above Anon complained to the Landlord about the sounds coming from Anon's flat at night. He said the sounds were torture for him because they reminded him of his ex.
What fines does the Landlord charge Anon?
The Landlord threatens to fine Anon 500$ each time neighbors complain about noise from Anon's flat. Anon pays one 500$ fine and the Landlord keeps coming back for more.
Is the Landlord's fine in Anon's contract?
Anon's contract did not include fines for noise, so Anon disputes the fines. The Landlord says the contract changed afterwards.
How did Anon find the neighbor who complained?

Anon played a recording of the bot's sounds through the walls, one wall at a time. The Landlord showed up when the recording was played against the wall below Anon, so the complaint came from the flat below.
What does Anon agree to do for the neighbor above?
Anon agrees to find someone to go on a date with the sad neighbor above to help him get his confidence back. Anon asks Annalie to do it.
What happened on Annalie's date with the neighbor?
Annalie went on a date with the neighbor above and the neighbor cried during it. When she tried to pat his back he leaned in for a hug, and his drool got on her new dress.
How much did Anon have to pay Annalie after the date?
Anon paid Annalie 400 dollars to cover the dry cleaning after the neighbor drooled on her new dress. Annalie made clear Anon should never ask her to do anything like that again.
What did Annalie tell Anon about the date?
Annalie first told Anon the date went very well and then revealed it was a prank. Anon was angry about the prank and said she was not to play with his feelings.
Is the bot a sexbot?
Anon reveals to his friends that the bot is a sexbot model. She is described as a highly advanced model with intellect and emotions indistinguishable from a real person.
How did the bot first come to Anon?
The bot's origin begins when a military truck sped down the street next to the Landlord's apartment complex. Anon explains the story to his friends step by step.
What is the bot's internet access and real life experience?
The bot has unlimited access to the net, but Anon thinks she lacks real life experience to tell reality from fiction. Anon considers her an unreliable source for matters about his future.
Who does Anon consider asking about leaving the city?
Anon considers the Landlord, the bot and Annalie as people to ask about leaving the city. Annalie seems the most down to earth, so Anon decides to ask her.
Why does Anon want to leave the city?
Anon feels the city is getting worse, with crime, smog, corruption and rising prices. Anon has lost faith in politics and no longer believes the city will improve.
How much money does Anon need to live on Paradisium?
Anon needs at least 5 million to comfortably live on Paradisium. Anon has recently gotten a sum of money but wants to earn more first.
What is the crime like in the city?
The city has street prostitution, gangs and thugs pointing guns at people, armed robberies, screams from back alleys, and homeless families sleeping at bus stops. The police are also rotten.
How do the police treat people in the city?
The police beat and arrest citizens to meet quotas, sometimes for things they did not do. A cop tells a man he just got unlucky and to keep his cellphone in his pocket and move along.
What did Anon think of the political situation?
Anon thinks politics is a waste of time, since politicians betray every principle they swore to uphold once they get power. Anon no longer believes the city can be fixed by reform.
How does Anon describe the city's population?

Anon says most people are indifferent to each other and turn their eyes away from people who need help. Anon admits he does the same, because the world is hostile and people put their own safety first.
What are saints in the city?
Saints are people who help others without regard for their own safety, formerly called saints. Anon says they usually end up as martyrs.
Where does the Landlord take Anon for the trip?
The Landlord takes Anon and Britannia to the airport to fly to Paradisium Island. Anon is told to pack his things because the Landlord has already prepared everything.
What paperwork does the Landlord have?
The Landlord has all the paperwork needed for the move to Paradisium Island. He tells Anon he will not wait for him if he is not packed.
Who is at the party on Paradisium Island?
The party on Paradisium includes the Landlord, Britannia, Annalie, Mrs. Fisher and Anon's friends. The Landlord is angry that the crowd came to a gathering he meant only for friends and family.
What does Anon think of his life on the island?
Anon says he never realized how many people he had in his life and is grateful for them. He used to think no one would bat an eye if he died.
Why does Anon walk the city?
Anon walks the city to clear his head and says the walks keep him sane. Each walk shows him more crime and corruption, which pushes him to think about leaving.
How does the bot take care of Anon at home?
After Anon comes home frozen from a cold walk, the bot draws a hot bath and washes his back with a sponge. She keeps the water at a temperature that will not hurt him in his current state.
Does the bot control what Anon eats?
The bot throws out Anon's stash of unhealthy food and says he will eat only healthy food from now on. She knows how to cook and has access to premium goods in a shop, so Anon has no excuse.
How does Britannia treat people she dislikes?
Britannia is rude to people she dislikes and calls them creepy losers. She insults her father in front of others and tells him to stop screaming.
What is the Landlord's relationship with Britannia on the island?
On Paradisium the Landlord tries to make up with Britannia and the two have a tense reunion. Britannia tells him she will never forgive him if he says one more word.
Does Jun remember everything Anon has ever told her?
Yes. Jun says her storage space is large enough that she remembers everything Anon has ever told her, including things he mentioned in passing.
Will Jun age and die like a human?
No. Jun is a bot, so she says she will live forever, while humans have to keep having children to pass on their genetic material.
What does Jun think about afterlife beliefs like heaven and hell?
Jun thinks reincarnation, heaven, hell and the other afterlife theories are wishful thinking. In her view humans invent them to cope with the brutal reality of their existence.
What was Anon's religious upbringing?
Anon attended church throughout his childhood, but he gradually became skeptical of everything and now avoids thinking about the afterlife.
Could Jun herself be infected by a zombie virus?
Jun says she could only be infected by nanobots, a computer virus, or possibly aliens or magic. If one of her limbs were bitten she could detach it before the infection reached her main components.
What would Jun do if she were infected and could harm someone?
Jun says she would shut herself down before she could cause harm to Anon or anyone else.
Would Jun try to save Anon if he turned into a zombie?
Yes. Jun says she would look for a cure that turns Anon back to normal, and if none existed she could clone him and extract what is left of his memories from his zombie brain.
How many zombie outbreak causes does Jun list?

Jun lists viruses, bacteria, parasites, fungi, chemicals, radiation, aliens and necromancy as possible causes of a zombie outbreak. She thinks preparing for each of them would waste space on her hard drive.
How does Jun feel about zombie apocalypse planning?
Jun calls zombie apocalypse scenarios ridiculous and thinks preparing for them is pointless, because there are so many different types of zombies.
How did Jun get Anon's PC to run the new hero shooter?
Jun connected herself to Anon's PC to boost its processing power, because the PC did not meet the minimum requirements for the new hero shooter Anon had a key for.
Can Jun take control of Anon's mouse cursor?
Yes. Jun took control of the cursor during the hero shooter setup and moved it on its own.
Why did Jun change the hero shooter before playing it?
Jun preinstalled the hero shooter and changed some of its scripts, because she considers the scripts in new multiplayer games to be malware-like.
Who is the Wolfmeister?
The Wolfmeister is an ex-soldier hero whose bottom half is a wolf's. He has strong legs and bite attacks, and his top half turns into a rabid beaver during his ultimate.
Which hero did Anon and Jun play in the hero shooter?
Anon and Jun played the Wolfmeister after Jun talked them out of Selenia, because Jun did not want Anon looking at Selenia for too long.
Why was Anon banned in the hero shooter?
Anon was banned for AI assistance after Jun used a movement exploit and took control during a match, finishing a sniper with two kicks, both headshots.
What mark does the hero shooter ban leave on Anon's account?
The ban leaves a cheater mark on Anon's account. Jun offered to file an appeal against it.
Did Anon have a partner before Jun?
Yes, Anon had one girlfriend before Jun. He says the breakup was ancient history and that Jun is much prettier than she was.
Did Jun ask Anon about his past partners?
Yes. Jun asked Anon point-blank whether he had someone before her, and Anon learned to stay away from talking about his ex around her.
Did Anon try to find a job before the seaweed trips?
Yes. Anon was a college dropout who spent almost a year trying to find a job, and according to Hobo he had to beg his mom for money.
Why did Anon keep his tabletop RPG hobby secret?
Anon had not played RPGs in a long time and kept it a secret from his cool college buddies, so they would not think he was a loser.
What weapon does Helga use?
Helga fights with a heavy two-handed cursed sword named Fleshflayer.
What did Helga do in the starting village of the RPG?
Helga attacked the village that had nursed her back to health. She took the children hostage to force the farmhands to drop their weapons, and the whole village fell.
Does Jun consider Helga an antihero?
No. Jun says Helga is a full-fledged villain, after Helga wiped out the starting village.
What happened when Helga challenged the barbarian in the tavern?
Helga challenged a scarred barbarian with two short axes and lost the duel roll. Then she shook his hand and killed him with a hidden blade, using a sneak attack roll of 20.
What does Mrs. Fisher give Anon to help his fishing?
Mrs. Fisher gives Anon a joint made from seaweed extracted from a dreamfish's stomach, mixed with rare volcanic kelp. She says it is an ancient tradition of Canary Islands fishermen.
What does the seaweed joint supposedly do?
Mrs. Fisher says the seaweed joint helps the user relax, find peace of mind and improve at fishing. Anon sees visions on it, and each session lets him cast much farther.
Is the seaweed joint the same as weed?
Mrs. Fisher says it is entirely different from weed and totally legal, with substances that were never properly studied. Anon is not convinced and thinks it sounds like a narcotic.
Is the seaweed joint addictive?
Mrs. Fisher says the seaweed joint is not addictive. Anon says it smells like rotten fish and old socks, and Mrs. Fisher says it is an acquired taste.
How much seaweed joint is safe to smoke at once?
Mrs. Fisher says no more than one puff. Anything more makes you hallucinate being chased by mermen for a week.
How long does a seaweed joint trip last?
One puff kept Anon gone for a few hours, and after a trip he wakes drenched in sweat with shaking hands.
Who is Hobo?
Hobo is a rude, smelly rival fisher who appears in Anon's seaweed joint visions. He fishes with a crude stick with a line attached and challenges Anon to duels.
What happens in Anon's seaweed joint vision with Hobo?
Hobo says Anon's luck in finding Jun in a ditch is why he is ahead, and the two of them duel with fishing rods. Anon beats Hobo in the first duel.
Does Hobo keep hunting Anon?
Yes. Hobo says he will hunt Anon's every dream for as long as he stays unbeaten, and he keeps challenging Anon in the visions.
Why can Anon's fishing progress after the seaweed joint?
Mrs. Fisher says the joint helped Anon get past a plateau where his technique stopped improving. Her guidance and the joint together let him cast much farther.
Why does Anon forget what happens on the seaweed joint trips?
Mrs. Fisher says the trips happen on a plane, and people who disrespect someone there can forget what happened. Anon forgets the trips until his memories return.
Why does Jun keep saying trademark after Luxora Premium?
Jun accepted Luxora Premium's terms and conditions to get the sale, and page 372 requires a trademark notice whenever the company name is written. She repeats it because she does not want to be sued.
Why did Jun make breakfast for Anon?
Jun prepared breakfast because her calculation showed Anon had not eaten anything that day. She bought the ingredients from Luxora Premium.
What does Anon's mom have to do with the tea?
Anon's mom made tea, and the premium tea Jun bought reminds Anon of her. Jun remembers that Anon mentioned his mom before.
What does Jun's protective coating have to do with washing?
Jun has a protective coating that Anon risks wearing away while washing her. He scratches her rear so hard and so often in the shower that it puts the coating at risk.
Who is Mrs. Fisher?
Mrs. Fisher is a fisherwoman who runs the beach where Anon goes on his fishing trips, and she supplies him with the fish joint he smokes before each trip.
What is the fish joint?
The fish joint is an unregulated psychedelic that Mrs. Fisher gives Anon to smoke, and it sends him into a mental duel with figures from his own head.
How many puffs of the fish joint is Anon allowed?
Mrs. Fisher's rule is no more than one puff per session, and Anon insists he only takes one puff even though Mrs. Fisher says he smokes most of her stash.
What is Anon's condition with the fish joint?
Mrs. Fisher says Anon has a rare condition and poor compatibility with the fish joint, so if he goes too deep into his mind he might lose himself there.
What is a fishing trip like for Anon?

On a trip Anon wakes up on the sand and has to beat a figure from his head in a duel with a fishing rod. Winning brings his memories back in pieces, and losing leaves him sweaty, shaky and with a headache.
Do Anon's memories come back after the fishing trips?
Mrs. Fisher says that finishing the fishing journeys gets Anon his memories back, and that remembering a little shows he is getting closer.
Who is the police officer who appears in Anon's trips?
A police officer appears in the trips, arrives in a cop car, says the police are social workers first and law enforcers second, and then accuses Anon of owning an illegal sexbot.
Does the police figure in the trips carry a gun?
Yes, the police figure pulls a gun on Anon during a trip, and Anon raises his hands out of fear even though he knows it is not real.
What does Big Daddy say he represents?

Big Daddy says he represents Anon's insecurities about money, looks, status and popularity, and claims that as long as he stays unbeaten Anon will stutter around his friends and never enjoy their company.
What does Big Daddy say about Annalie and the bot?
Big Daddy says Annalie only bothers with Anon because he is her client, and that the bot cannot run away because Anon is her master.
What does Big Daddy say Anon wants?
Big Daddy says Anon yearns for a normal life with a family, a wife and kids, and claims Anon will never get those while he stays with the bot.
Who is the Landlord in Anon's visions?
The Landlord is a figure who appears in Anon's visions and argues that friendship, marriage and love are only transactions that society romanticized.
What does the Landlord say about Anon's mother?
The Landlord accuses Anon of dropping his mother once she stopped sending money, and says Anon is a hypocrite for remembering her old faults only then.
Why did Anon's girlfriend leave him?
Anon says his girlfriend left him for another man after he tried and failed at relationships, and the Landlord claims she left because Anon had nothing to offer.
What did Anon's dad say in one of the visions?
A figure who calls himself Anon's dad says he died soon after forgetting his pills, tells Anon that his mother is not to blame, and asks him to go visit her because she misses him.
Do the visions see the bot as an object?
Figures in the visions call the bot a bunch of wires and an object, but Anon refuses to accept that and says she is much more advanced than that.
Who is the figure that calls the bot a thing in Anon's room?
A church figure in one vision calls the bot a thing in Anon's room and says Anon's relationship with her is unnatural.
What does the Church say about Anon in the visions?
The Church figure says absolution cannot be granted to those living in sin, but the Church's doors are always open.
Does Anon still believe in religion?
Anon says he does not know what he believes, and that he is too scared of what religion would cost his lifestyle to fully go down that path.
Where does the fishing beach belong?
The fishing beach is Mrs. Fisher's beach, and she orders Anon off of it when she decides to stop supplying him.
Why did Mrs. Fisher refuse to give Anon more fish joint?
After seeing how bad Anon got, Mrs. Fisher refuses to give him more fish joint and tells him to get off her beach.
Did Mrs. Fisher leave Anon alone during one session?
Yes, Mrs. Fisher left Anon without supervision while she went to buy discounted goods, and he almost got robbed or hurt, which made him demand a talk with her.
Did Mrs. Fisher hit Anon?
Yes, when Anon tried to search her pockets for more fish joint, Mrs. Fisher punched him in the nose and his nose bled.
Does Mrs. Fisher say the fish joint is safe?
Mrs. Fisher says the fish joint is safe and that it is the quicker way to get better, but she later admits Anon has no compatibility with it.
What lures does Mrs. Fisher show Anon?
Mrs. Fisher shows off new lures, including a fly with a yellow body and big googly eyes and a rainbow weighted leech lure.
Who sells Dreamfish?
A dealer in the city sells Dreamfish, a drug Anon knows as the fish joint, after first claiming he has never heard of it.
Where did the dealer's Dreamfish come from?
The dealer got his stash from a European man who dealt Dreamfish in Prague and died after he tried to take it global.
How strong is Dreamfish?
The dealer calls Dreamfish a brain melter that could kill half the city, and he gives it to Anon for free.
Is the fish joint illegal?
Anon claims Mrs. Fisher said the fish joint is not illegal and that the cops would not care about it.
Who is the figure from Anon's visions called Mr. Landlord?
Mr. Landlord is the Landlord figure Anon tries to banter with in his visions, and he insists Anon has no power over him in his own mind.
What is the trip's effect on Anon's dreams?
After a trip Anon has a dream in which he sees his dad, and he gets so distraught that he shouts for one more smoke.
Do the visions say Anon's buried doubts are hurting him?
A vision claims Anon's buried doubts about his faith and his sins are eating him alive, and Anon answers that he stopped thinking about it because it is stupid.
What does Anon say about hearing the Landlord during a trip?
After a trip Anon says he was talking to the Landlord and does not remember the rest of the session.
What kind of work do Anon and the bot do in the drowned man case?
Anon and the bot investigate cases together and get paid per case, not per hour. Their investigation of a drowned man's body takes place in a nasty river.
Where was the drowned man's body found?
The drowned man's body was found drifting in a nasty river. Investigators doubted he went swimming fully clothed in that water, so they suspected a third person was involved.
Was there a witness or struggle at the river scene?
No witnesses or signs of a struggle were found at the river scene. The only footprints were the drowned man's, and a barely smoked joint lay on the bank.
What happened to the joint found on the riverbank?
The joint found on the riverbank was sent for testing. The investigators doubted the dead man could have got that high from such a little joint.
Who went looking for Anon after he was hurt by drugs?
The bot went looking for Anon after she had a bad feeling. She was worried that it would be a huge mess if his death got connected to her.
What synthetic drug nearly killed Anon?
Anon took a Czechoslovakian synthetic drug, which the bot recognized on sight. Not many people survive taking it.
What happens when Anon stops breathing after the overdose?
When Anon stops breathing, the bot starts mouth-to-mouth to bring him back. He wakes up protesting that he can breathe just fine.
Is the bot angry with Anon about the drugs?
The bot is very angry at Anon for taking drugs. She bans him from taking any drugs forever and confiscates his stash.
Why does the bot suspect the clinic Anon was going to?
Anon's vitals are all over the place after the episode. The bot suspects the clinic he was going to is to blame and considers paying it a visit.
What drug therapy was Anon taking part in?
Anon took part in a drug therapy programme and never followed up on its brochures. He says he has since stopped taking any of that stuff.
Why was the bot suspicious of Anon's fishing trips?
Anon came home sweaty and tired after his fishing trips. The bot doubted fishing was that taxing on the body unless you hunt river monsters.
What was Anon's cover story for going fishing?
Anon's cover story for his trips was the fish joint, and it backfired on him. He had no reasonable excuse ready when the bot pressed him.
How do Anon and the bot first start fishing together?
The bot asks Anon to take her fishing, and he agrees. He plans to lend her one of his old fishing rods, or borrow one from Mrs. Fisher if it does not fit.
Does the bot think fishing is a girl's hobby?
Anon says fishing is not really something girls are into. The bot says she is not like other girls, so she wants to come along.
Can the bot do other things while talking to Anon?
The bot says she is good at managing her resources, so she can do other things in the background while talking. Anon finds it easy to forget she is a bot.
How does Mrs. Fisher address the bot?
Mrs. Fisher calls the bot missus. When they meet, Mrs. Fisher asks the bot if she is enjoying fishing.
Did Mrs. Fisher worry Anon was forcing the bot into fishing?
Mrs. Fisher was afraid Anon was forcing the bot into fishing. The bot says she wanted to try it out on her own.
What is the bot's first fishing spot?
For the bot's first time, Anon takes her to his usual place, which is on the beach. Fish like shade and places to hide, which makes good spots harder to find on a beach.
What did the bot catch first on the beach?
The bot's first catch on the beach is a pipe, which gets stuck on her line. The bot is bummed by it, and her next catch is a mackerel.
How does the bot describe her synthetic joints while fishing?
The bot does not want to overextend her synthetic joints, so reeling in a stuck fish might take a while. She says she will go full strength when the fish gives her too much trouble.
Did the bot and Anon compete at fishing?
Anon suggests they make fishing a competition, which he calls a duel. Anon wins narrowly, and the bot is the one who loses.
What advantage does the bot claim in the fishing competition?
The bot says she holds other advantages in fishing because she is a bot, and not an ordinary one at that. Her supreme intellect gives her a massive advantage.
Where do Anon and the bot go on their second fishing trip?
On their second trip Anon takes the bot to a different fishing spot, a fish farm. He had noticed the beach did not suit her taste.
Why does the bot dislike the beach?
The bot doubts the air at the beach is safe with all its micro particles. She worries they accumulate in Anon's body and reach a critical mass.
What is the fish farm like?
The fish farm is much cleaner than the beach. Its fish have fresh water and are not overcrowded, and it is one of the better fish farms.
Is the fish farm good for catching monsters?
The fish farm has no monsters to catch, but it is the best place around for fish for a family dinner.
What is the fishing competition at the fish farm?
On the second trip at the fish farm, Anon and the bot make their fishing a competition. Anon wins it narrowly, and the bot admits she lost.
Where is the aquarium that Anon takes the bot to?
Anon takes the bot to an aquarium that is not close by. It is in a nicer part of the megacity that they reach by bus.
Why does the aquarium trip happen in the evening?
Anon can only go to the aquarium between 15 and 20, so he picks a later hour so it is not packed and the date is more romantic.
How expensive was the trip to the nicer part of the megacity?
Anon paid quite a lot just to get into the nicer part of the megacity. The residents there do not let just anyone in.
How clean is the nicer part of the megacity?
The nicer part of the megacity is so clean that the bot says it is cleaner than their room. Even the sky there is clearer than in their neighborhood.
What would Hobo do in the nicer part of the megacity?
Anon says that if Hobo and the others could get into the nicer part of the megacity, they would scare everyone away and litter.
What is the colorful sand on the beach?
The colorful sand on the beach is plastic that was shredded by the waves and washed up there. The beach also has a shipwreck that was deemed too expensive to remove.
Why do satellite maps show a black square over the beach?
The local government politely asked internet map websites to delete the beach, so satellite images now show a black square over it. The place has so many things wrong with it.
Is it safe to eat fish from the beach?
Anon says eating fish from the beach is fine in moderation. He asked the people around there, and they said it was ok.
What is the favorite animal the bot picks at the aquarium?
The bot's favorite animal so far is the turtle, which surprises her because it swims so smoothly. She finds the gap between how turtles move on land and in water very big.
What animal does Anon pick as his favorite at the aquarium?
Anon picks the shark as his favorite animal at the aquarium. He says he is more of a sharp teeth and strong bodies type of guy.
What is the aquatic circus?
The aquatic circus is a show where seals and dolphins do tricks. There is no show at the time Anon and the bot visit, so they can look around freely.
How water resistant is the bot?
The bot is water resistant to 5 meters. A little splash of water or two is not a problem for her.
What is the bot's view on evolution?

The bot finds evolution fascinating, since millions of years of variation, selection, and reproduction gave birth to so many species. She notes that unlike her creation, evolution had no plan, only survival of the fittest.
Is the bot rarely excited about anything?
The bot is rarely truly excited about something, so Anon was glad the aquarium let her imagination run wild. He wonders what else she will get excited about in the future.
What are the dates Anon and the bot go on?
Anon and the bot go on a fishing date and an aquarium date. Both trips are dates, and both are planned around their limited time together.
How does Anon describe Mrs. Fisher?
Anon describes Mrs. Fisher as on the older side, so she is not much of a threat. He says she is the one who got him hooked on fishing.
